decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCycles
decls.doc: The cycles of the fully blocked grid differential: chains killed by `∂`.
decls.statement: def fullyBlockedCycles : Submodule (ZMod 2) (GridChain (ZMod 2) n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries
decls.doc: The boundaries of the fully blocked grid differential: chains hit by `∂`.
decls.statement: def fullyBlockedBoundaries : Submodule (ZMod 2) (GridChain (ZMod 2) n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedCycles
decls.doc: A chain is a fully blocked cycle exactly when its differential vanishes.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedCycles (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    c ∈ G.fullyBlockedCycles ↔ G.fullyBlockedDifferential c = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedBoundaries
decls.doc: A chain is a fully blocked boundary exactly when it is the differential of some chain.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedBoundaries (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    c ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries ↔
      ∃ b : GridChain (ZMod 2) n, G.fullyBlockedDifferential b = c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCycles_eq_ker
decls.doc:
The fully blocked cycle submodule is the kernel of the fully blocked differential, restated
so that downstream files can rewrite with it without unfolding the definition.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCycles_eq_ker :
    G.fullyBlockedCycles = LinearMap.ker G.fullyBlockedDifferential

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries_eq_range
decls.doc:
The fully blocked boundary submodule is the range of the fully blocked differential, restated
so that downstream files can rewrite with it without unfolding the definition.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundaries_eq_range :
    G.fullyBlockedBoundaries = LinearMap.range G.fullyBlockedDifferential

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries_le_cycles
decls.doc: Boundaries lie in cycles once the fully blocked differential is square-zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundaries_le_cycles
    (hsq : G.fullyBlockedDifferential.comp G.fullyBlockedDifferential = 0) :
    G.fullyBlockedBoundaries ≤ G.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCycles_eq_top_of_fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero
decls.doc: The fully blocked cycle submodule is top when the differential is the zero map.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCycles_eq_top_of_fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero
    (h : G.fullyBlockedDifferential =
      (0 : GridChain (ZMod 2) n →ₗ[ZMod 2] GridChain (ZMod 2) n)) :
    G.fullyBlockedCycles = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries_eq_bot_of_fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero
decls.doc: The fully blocked boundary submodule is bottom when the differential is the zero map.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundaries_eq_bot_of_fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero
    (h : G.fullyBlockedDifferential =
      (0 : GridChain (ZMod 2) n →ₗ[ZMod 2] GridChain (ZMod 2) n)) :
    G.fullyBlockedBoundaries = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangles
decls.doc:
The finite set of fully blocked empty rectangles from `x` to `y` in a grid diagram.

"Fully blocked" means that the rectangle is empty for the source grid state and its interior
avoids every `O` and `X` marking. This is the rectangle set whose parity gives the coefficient
of `y` in the fully blocked grid differential applied to `x`.
decls.statement: def fullyBlockedRectangles : Finset (GridRectangleBetween x y)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedRectangles
decls.doc:
Membership in the fully blocked rectangle set is emptiness together with marking
avoidance.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedRectangles (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    R ∈ G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y ↔ R.IsEmpty ∧ R.AvoidsMarkings G

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isEmpty_of_mem_fullyBlockedRectangles
decls.doc: Every fully blocked rectangle is empty.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_of_mem_fullyBlockedRectangles {R : GridRectangleBetween x y}
    (hR : R ∈ G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y) : R.IsEmpty

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.avoidsMarkings_of_mem_fullyBlockedRectangles
decls.doc: Every fully blocked rectangle avoids the `O` and `X` markings.
decls.statement:
theorem avoidsMarkings_of_mem_fullyBlockedRectangles {R : GridRectangleBetween x y}
    (hR : R ∈ G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y) : R.AvoidsMarkings G

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangles_subset_emptyRectangles
decls.doc: Fully blocked rectangles are a subset of the empty rectangles between the same states.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangles_subset_emptyRectangles :
    G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y ⊆ GridRectangleBetween.emptyRectangles x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangles_subset_all
decls.doc: Fully blocked rectangles are a subset of all rectangles between the same states.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangles_subset_all :
    G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y ⊆ GridRectangleBetween.all x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.card_fullyBlockedRectangles_le_two
decls.doc:
There are at most two fully blocked rectangles in each matrix coefficient of the fully
blocked differential.
decls.statement:
theorem card_fullyBlockedRectangles_le_two :
    (G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y).card ≤ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangleCount
decls.doc: The number of fully blocked empty rectangles from `x` to `y`, reduced modulo `2`.
decls.statement: def fullyBlockedRectangleCount : ZMod 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangleCount_def
decls.doc:
The fully blocked rectangle count is the cardinality of `fullyBlockedRectangles`, coerced
to `ZMod 2`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangleCount_def :
    G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y = ((G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y).card : ZMod 2)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.exists_swapColumns_of_fullyBlockedRectangleCount_ne_zero
decls.doc:
A nonzero fully blocked rectangle count forces the target state to be a column transposition
of the source state: a nonzero count means there is a fully blocked rectangle, hence an oriented
rectangle, between the two states.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_swapColumns_of_fullyBlockedRectangleCount_ne_zero
    (h : G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b ∧ y = x.swapColumns a b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangles_self
decls.doc: The set of fully blocked rectangles from a grid state to itself is empty.
decls.statement: theorem fullyBlockedRectangles_self (x : GridState n) : G.fullyBlockedRectangles x x = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangleCount_self
decls.doc: The fully blocked rectangle count from a grid state to itself is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangleCount_self (x : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedRectangles_transpose
decls.doc:
The diagonal reflection of a fully blocked rectangle is a fully blocked rectangle for the
reflected diagram.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedRectangles_transpose (x y : GridState n) (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    R.transpose ∈ G.transpose.fullyBlockedRectangles x.transpose y.transpose ↔
      R ∈ G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangleCount_transpose
decls.doc:
The fully blocked rectangle count is invariant under the diagonal reflection of a grid
diagram and its two states. This is the matrix-coefficient form of the statement that the
diagonal reflection is a chain symmetry of the fully blocked grid complex.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangleCount_transpose (x y : GridState n) :
    G.transpose.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x.transpose y.transpose =
      G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedRectangles_rotate
decls.doc:
The half-turn rotation of a fully blocked rectangle is a fully blocked rectangle for the
rotated diagram and rotated states.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedRectangles_rotate (x y : GridState n) (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    R.rotate ∈ G.rotate.fullyBlockedRectangles x.rotate y.rotate ↔
      R ∈ G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangleCount_rotate
decls.doc:
The fully blocked rectangle count is invariant under the half-turn rotation of a grid diagram
and its two states. This is the matrix-coefficient form of the statement that the half-turn
rotation is a chain symmetry of the fully blocked grid complex.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangleCount_rotate (x y : GridState n) :
    G.rotate.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x.rotate y.rotate =
      G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangles_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
The fully blocked rectangles are unchanged by swapping the `O` and `X` markings, since
marking avoidance only refers to the union of the two marking sets.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangles_swapMarkings (x y : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.fullyBlockedRectangles x y = G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangleCount_swapMarkings
decls.doc: The fully blocked rectangle count is invariant under swapping the `O` and `X` markings.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangleCount_swapMarkings (x y : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y = G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.card
decls.doc:
The number of chains over a finite coefficient type is `#R ^ n!`.

This is the exact size of the finite search space for the ambient free module on grid states.
decls.statement:
theorem card (R : Type*) [Zero R] [Fintype R] (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (GridChain R n) = Fintype.card R ^ n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.natCard
decls.doc: The natural cardinality of chains over a finite coefficient type is `Nat.card R ^ n!`.
decls.statement:
theorem natCard (R : Type*) [Zero R] [Finite R] (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (GridChain R n) = Nat.card R ^ n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.support_card_le_factorial
decls.doc:
The support of any grid chain has at most `n!` generators.

This is the chain-level version of `GridState.card_univ`; it bounds the number of potentially
nonzero coefficients in any explicit finite chain.
decls.statement:
theorem support_card_le_factorial {R : Type*} [Zero R] {n : ℕ} (c : GridChain R n) :
    c.support.card ≤ n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.card_zmod_two
decls.doc: The fully blocked `ZMod 2` chain module has `2 ^ n!` elements.
decls.statement:
theorem card_zmod_two (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (GridChain (ZMod 2) n) = 2 ^ n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.natCard_zmod_two
decls.doc: The natural cardinality of the fully blocked `ZMod 2` chain module is `2 ^ n!`.
decls.statement:
theorem natCard_zmod_two (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (GridChain (ZMod 2) n) = 2 ^ n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.card_zmod_two_zero
decls.doc: There are two `ZMod 2` chains on the empty grid.
decls.statement: theorem card_zmod_two_zero : Fintype.card (GridChain (ZMod 2) 0) = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.card_zmod_two_one
decls.doc: There are two `ZMod 2` chains on a `1 × 1` grid.
decls.statement: theorem card_zmod_two_one : Fintype.card (GridChain (ZMod 2) 1) = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.card_zmod_two_two
decls.doc: There are four `ZMod 2` chains on a `2 × 2` grid.
decls.statement: theorem card_zmod_two_two : Fintype.card (GridChain (ZMod 2) 2) = 4

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.finite
decls.doc: A finite coefficient grid chain module is finite.
decls.statement: instance finite (R : Type*) [Zero R] [Finite R] (n : ℕ) : Finite (GridChain R n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnArc
decls.doc:
The open vertical arc from the `O` marking to the `X` marking in a column of a grid diagram.

This is the one-dimensional cyclic interval in the row coordinate. Its opposite arc is obtained by
swapping the two markings, not by changing the column.
decls.statement: def columnArc (c : Fin n) : Finset (Fin n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_columnArc
decls.doc:
Membership in a column arc is membership in the open cyclic interval from that column's `O`
row to its `X` row.
decls.statement: theorem mem_columnArc (c r : Fin n) : r ∈ columnArc G c ↔ r ∈ Grid.cIoo (G.O c) (G.X c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.O_notMem_columnArc
decls.doc: The `O` endpoint of a column is not in its own open column arc.
decls.statement: theorem O_notMem_columnArc (c : Fin n) : G.O c ∉ columnArc G c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.X_notMem_columnArc
decls.doc: The `X` endpoint of a column is not in its own open column arc.
decls.statement: theorem X_notMem_columnArc (c : Fin n) : G.X c ∉ columnArc G c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowArc
decls.doc:
The open horizontal arc from the `O` marking to the `X` marking in a row of a grid diagram.

This is the column-coordinate version of `columnArc`: it starts at the unique column containing
the row's `O` marking and ends at the unique column containing the row's `X` marking.
decls.statement: def rowArc (r : Fin n) : Finset (Fin n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_rowArc
decls.doc:
Membership in a row arc is membership in the open cyclic interval from that row's `O` column
to its `X` column.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_rowArc (r c : Fin n) :
    c ∈ rowArc G r ↔ c ∈ Grid.cIoo (OColumnOfRow G r) (XColumnOfRow G r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OColumn_notMem_rowArc
decls.doc: The `O` endpoint of a row is not in its own open row arc.
decls.statement: theorem OColumn_notMem_rowArc (r : Fin n) : OColumnOfRow G r ∉ rowArc G r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumn_notMem_rowArc
decls.doc: The `X` endpoint of a row is not in its own open row arc.
decls.statement: theorem XColumn_notMem_rowArc (r : Fin n) : XColumnOfRow G r ∉ rowArc G r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.ColumnsNoninterleaving
decls.doc:
Two columns of a grid diagram have non-interleaving marking segments.

The condition is phrased in both directions: the two endpoints in column `a` lie on the same side
of the endpoint pair in column `b`, and conversely. This symmetric form is robust in degenerate
row-sharing cases, where one endpoint of a segment may have the same row coordinate as an endpoint
of the other segment.
decls.statement: def ColumnsNoninterleaving (a b : Fin n) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.RowsNoninterleaving
decls.doc: Two rows of a grid diagram have non-interleaving marking segments.
decls.statement: def RowsNoninterleaving (a b : Fin n) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnsNoninterleaving_iff
decls.doc: The defining endpoint-side conditions for column non-interleaving.
decls.statement:
theorem columnsNoninterleaving_iff (a b : Fin n) :
    ColumnsNoninterleaving G a b ↔
      (G.O a ∈ columnArc G b ↔ G.X a ∈ columnArc G b) ∧
        (G.O b ∈ columnArc G a ↔ G.X b ∈ columnArc G a)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowsNoninterleaving_iff
decls.doc: The defining endpoint-side conditions for row non-interleaving.
decls.statement:
theorem rowsNoninterleaving_iff (a b : Fin n) :
    RowsNoninterleaving G a b ↔
      (OColumnOfRow G a ∈ rowArc G b ↔ XColumnOfRow G a ∈ rowArc G b) ∧
        (OColumnOfRow G b ∈ rowArc G a ↔ XColumnOfRow G b ∈ rowArc G a)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnsNoninterleaving_self
decls.doc: A column is non-interleaving with itself.
decls.statement: theorem columnsNoninterleaving_self (a : Fin n) : ColumnsNoninterleaving G a a

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowsNoninterleaving_self
decls.doc: A row is non-interleaving with itself.
decls.statement: theorem rowsNoninterleaving_self (a : Fin n) : RowsNoninterleaving G a a

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnsNoninterleaving_comm
decls.doc: Column non-interleaving is symmetric in the two columns.
decls.statement:
theorem columnsNoninterleaving_comm {a b : Fin n} :
    ColumnsNoninterleaving G a b ↔ ColumnsNoninterleaving G b a

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowsNoninterleaving_comm
decls.doc: Row non-interleaving is symmetric in the two rows.
decls.statement:
theorem rowsNoninterleaving_comm {a b : Fin n} :
    RowsNoninterleaving G a b ↔ RowsNoninterleaving G b a

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowArc_transpose
decls.doc:
Diagonal reflection turns the row arc in the reflected diagram into the column arc in the
original diagram.
decls.statement: theorem rowArc_transpose (c : Fin n) : rowArc G.transpose c = columnArc G c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnArc_transpose
decls.doc:
Diagonal reflection turns the column arc in the reflected diagram into the row arc in the
original diagram.
decls.statement: theorem columnArc_transpose (r : Fin n) : columnArc G.transpose r = rowArc G r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowsNoninterleaving_transpose
decls.doc: Diagonal reflection exchanges row non-interleaving with column non-interleaving.
decls.statement:
theorem rowsNoninterleaving_transpose (a b : Fin n) :
    RowsNoninterleaving G.transpose a b ↔ ColumnsNoninterleaving G a b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnsNoninterleaving_transpose
decls.doc: Diagonal reflection exchanges column non-interleaving with row non-interleaving.
decls.statement:
theorem columnsNoninterleaving_transpose (a b : Fin n) :
    ColumnsNoninterleaving G.transpose a b ↔ RowsNoninterleaving G a b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsRowCommutation.componentPerm_eq
decls.doc: A row commutation leaves the component traversal permutation unchanged.
decls.statement:
theorem IsRowCommutation.componentPerm_eq (h : IsRowCommutation G G') :
    G'.componentPerm = G.componentPerm

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsColumnCommutation.componentPerm_eq_conj
decls.doc:
A column commutation conjugates the component traversal permutation by the transposition
of the exchanged columns.
decls.statement:
theorem IsColumnCommutation.componentPerm_eq_conj (h : IsColumnCommutation G G') :
    ∃ a : Fin n, G'.componentPerm =
      Equiv.swap a (finRotate n a) * G.componentPerm *
        (Equiv.swap a (finRotate n a))⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsRowCommutation.componentCycleType_eq
decls.doc: A row commutation preserves the multiset of component sizes.
decls.statement:
theorem IsRowCommutation.componentCycleType_eq (h : IsRowCommutation G G') :
    G'.componentCycleType = G.componentCycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsColumnCommutation.componentCycleType_eq
decls.doc: A column commutation preserves the multiset of component sizes.
decls.statement:
theorem IsColumnCommutation.componentCycleType_eq (h : IsColumnCommutation G G') :
    G'.componentCycleType = G.componentCycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsCommutation.componentCycleType_eq
decls.doc: Every elementary commutation preserves the multiset of component sizes.
decls.statement:
theorem IsCommutation.componentCycleType_eq (h : IsCommutation G G') :
    G'.componentCycleType = G.componentCycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsCommutation.componentCount_eq
decls.doc: Every elementary commutation preserves the number of represented link components.
decls.statement:
theorem IsCommutation.componentCount_eq (h : IsCommutation G G') :
    G'.componentCount = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsRowCommutation.componentCount_eq
decls.doc: A row commutation preserves the number of represented link components.
decls.statement:
theorem IsRowCommutation.componentCount_eq (h : IsRowCommutation G G') :
    G'.componentCount = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsColumnCommutation.componentCount_eq
decls.doc: A column commutation preserves the number of represented link components.
decls.statement:
theorem IsColumnCommutation.componentCount_eq (h : IsColumnCommutation G G') :
    G'.componentCount = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsCommutation.isKnot_iff
decls.doc: Every elementary commutation preserves whether a grid diagram represents a knot.
decls.statement:
theorem IsCommutation.isKnot_iff (h : IsCommutation G G') :
    G'.IsKnot ↔ G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsRowCommutation.isKnot_iff
decls.doc: A row commutation preserves whether a grid diagram represents a knot.
decls.statement:
theorem IsRowCommutation.isKnot_iff (h : IsRowCommutation G G') :
    G'.IsKnot ↔ G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsColumnCommutation.isKnot_iff
decls.doc: A column commutation preserves whether a grid diagram represents a knot.
decls.statement:
theorem IsColumnCommutation.isKnot_iff (h : IsColumnCommutation G G') :
    G'.IsKnot ↔ G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsColumnCommutation
decls.doc:
Two grid diagrams differ by one elementary column commutation.

The columns are consecutive in the cyclic order on `Fin n`, have non-interleaving marking
segments in the source diagram, and are swapped to obtain the target diagram.
decls.statement: def IsColumnCommutation (G G' : GridDiagram n) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isColumnCommutation_iff
decls.doc: Characterization of an elementary column commutation by its exchanged columns.
decls.statement:
theorem isColumnCommutation_iff (G G' : GridDiagram n) :
    IsColumnCommutation G G' ↔
      ∃ a : Fin n, a ≠ finRotate n a ∧
        ColumnsNoninterleaving G a (finRotate n a) ∧
          G' = G.swapColumns a (finRotate n a)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isColumnCommutation_swapColumns
decls.doc: Swapping a cyclically adjacent non-interleaving pair of columns is a column commutation.
decls.statement:
theorem isColumnCommutation_swapColumns (G : GridDiagram n) (a : Fin n)
    (ha : a ≠ finRotate n a) (hG : ColumnsNoninterleaving G a (finRotate n a)) :
    IsColumnCommutation G (G.swapColumns a (finRotate n a))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isColumnCommutation_comm
decls.doc: An elementary column commutation is reversible.
decls.statement:
theorem isColumnCommutation_comm {G G' : GridDiagram n} :
    IsColumnCommutation G G' ↔ IsColumnCommutation G' G

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsRowCommutation
decls.doc:
Two grid diagrams differ by one elementary row commutation.

The rows are consecutive in the cyclic order on `Fin n`, have non-interleaving marking
segments in the source diagram, and are swapped to obtain the target diagram.
decls.statement: def IsRowCommutation (G G' : GridDiagram n) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isRowCommutation_iff
decls.doc: Characterization of an elementary row commutation by its exchanged rows.
decls.statement:
theorem isRowCommutation_iff (G G' : GridDiagram n) :
    IsRowCommutation G G' ↔
      ∃ a : Fin n, a ≠ finRotate n a ∧
        RowsNoninterleaving G a (finRotate n a) ∧
          G' = G.swapRows a (finRotate n a)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isRowCommutation_swapRows
decls.doc: Swapping a cyclically adjacent non-interleaving pair of rows is a row commutation.
decls.statement:
theorem isRowCommutation_swapRows (G : GridDiagram n) (a : Fin n)
    (ha : a ≠ finRotate n a) (hG : RowsNoninterleaving G a (finRotate n a)) :
    IsRowCommutation G (G.swapRows a (finRotate n a))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isRowCommutation_comm
decls.doc: An elementary row commutation is reversible.
decls.statement:
theorem isRowCommutation_comm {G G' : GridDiagram n} :
    IsRowCommutation G G' ↔ IsRowCommutation G' G

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isRowCommutation_transpose
decls.doc: Diagonal reflection turns a row commutation into a column commutation.
decls.statement:
theorem isRowCommutation_transpose (G G' : GridDiagram n) :
    IsRowCommutation G.transpose G'.transpose ↔ IsColumnCommutation G G'

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isColumnCommutation_transpose
decls.doc: Diagonal reflection turns a column commutation into a row commutation.
decls.statement:
theorem isColumnCommutation_transpose (G G' : GridDiagram n) :
    IsColumnCommutation G.transpose G'.transpose ↔ IsRowCommutation G G'

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsCommutation
decls.doc: One elementary grid commutation, either of rows or of columns.
decls.statement: def IsCommutation (G G' : GridDiagram n) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isCommutation_iff
decls.doc:
A commutation is either an elementary row commutation or an elementary column
commutation.
decls.statement:
theorem isCommutation_iff (G G' : GridDiagram n) :
    IsCommutation G G' ↔ IsRowCommutation G G' ∨ IsColumnCommutation G G'

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isCommutation_comm
decls.doc: The elementary grid commutation relation is symmetric.
decls.statement:
theorem isCommutation_comm {G G' : GridDiagram n} :
    IsCommutation G G' ↔ IsCommutation G' G

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isCommutation_transpose
decls.doc:
Diagonal reflection preserves the elementary commutation relation, exchanging row and
column moves.
decls.statement:
theorem isCommutation_transpose (G G' : GridDiagram n) :
    IsCommutation G.transpose G'.transpose ↔ IsCommutation G G'

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnArc_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Column relabeling only renames the column whose vertical arc is being read.
decls.statement:
theorem columnArc_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c : Fin n) :
    columnArc (G.relabelColumns κ) c = columnArc G (κ.symm c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_columnArc_relabelColumns
decls.doc:
Membership in a column arc after column relabeling is membership in the old arc with the
inverse column label.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_columnArc_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c r : Fin n) :
    r ∈ columnArc (G.relabelColumns κ) c ↔ r ∈ columnArc G (κ.symm c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnArc_swapColumns
decls.doc: A column swap renames the column whose vertical arc is being read.
decls.statement:
theorem columnArc_swapColumns (a b c : Fin n) :
    columnArc (G.swapColumns a b) c = columnArc G (Equiv.swap a b c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_columnArc_swapColumns
decls.doc:
Membership in a column arc after a column swap is membership in the old arc with the swapped
column label.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_columnArc_swapColumns (a b c r : Fin n) :
    r ∈ columnArc (G.swapColumns a b) c ↔ r ∈ columnArc G (Equiv.swap a b c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnsNoninterleaving_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Column non-interleaving is transported by column relabeling through the inverse labels.
decls.statement:
theorem columnsNoninterleaving_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a b : Fin n) :
    ColumnsNoninterleaving (G.relabelColumns κ) a b ↔
      ColumnsNoninterleaving G (κ.symm a) (κ.symm b)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnsNoninterleaving_swapColumns
decls.doc: Column non-interleaving is transported by a column swap through the swapped labels.
decls.statement:
theorem columnsNoninterleaving_swapColumns (a b c d : Fin n) :
    ColumnsNoninterleaving (G.swapColumns a b) c d ↔
      ColumnsNoninterleaving G (Equiv.swap a b c) (Equiv.swap a b d)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowArc_relabelRows
decls.doc: Row relabeling only renames the row whose horizontal arc is being read.
decls.statement:
theorem rowArc_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r : Fin n) :
    rowArc (G.relabelRows ρ) r = rowArc G (ρ.symm r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_rowArc_relabelRows
decls.doc:
Membership in a row arc after row relabeling is membership in the old arc with the inverse
row label.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_rowArc_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r c : Fin n) :
    c ∈ rowArc (G.relabelRows ρ) r ↔ c ∈ rowArc G (ρ.symm r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowArc_swapRows
decls.doc: A row swap renames the row whose horizontal arc is being read.
decls.statement:
theorem rowArc_swapRows (a b r : Fin n) :
    rowArc (G.swapRows a b) r = rowArc G (Equiv.swap a b r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_rowArc_swapRows
decls.doc:
Membership in a row arc after a row swap is membership in the old arc with the swapped row
label.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_rowArc_swapRows (a b r c : Fin n) :
    c ∈ rowArc (G.swapRows a b) r ↔ c ∈ rowArc G (Equiv.swap a b r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowsNoninterleaving_relabelRows
decls.doc: Row non-interleaving is transported by row relabeling through the inverse labels.
decls.statement:
theorem rowsNoninterleaving_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a b : Fin n) :
    RowsNoninterleaving (G.relabelRows ρ) a b ↔
      RowsNoninterleaving G (ρ.symm a) (ρ.symm b)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowsNoninterleaving_swapRows
decls.doc: Row non-interleaving is transported by a row swap through the swapped labels.
decls.statement:
theorem rowsNoninterleaving_swapRows (a b c d : Fin n) :
    RowsNoninterleaving (G.swapRows a b) c d ↔
      RowsNoninterleaving G (Equiv.swap a b c) (Equiv.swap a b d)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnArc_rotate
decls.doc:
The column arc of the rotated diagram is the coordinate reversal of the opposite oriented
column arc in the original diagram. The `swapMarkings` appears because `Fin.rev` reverses the
cyclic orientation.
decls.statement:
theorem columnArc_rotate (c : Fin n) :
    columnArc G.rotate c = (columnArc G.swapMarkings c.rev).image Fin.rev

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_columnArc_rotate
decls.doc:
Membership in a rotated column arc is membership of the reversed row in the opposite oriented
column arc of the original diagram.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_columnArc_rotate (c r : Fin n) :
    r ∈ columnArc G.rotate c ↔ r.rev ∈ columnArc G.swapMarkings c.rev

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.columnsNoninterleaving_rotate
decls.doc:
Column non-interleaving is preserved by half-turn rotation, with the cyclic orientation
reversal accounted for by swapping the two marking states.
decls.statement:
theorem columnsNoninterleaving_rotate (a b : Fin n) :
    ColumnsNoninterleaving G.rotate a b ↔
      ColumnsNoninterleaving G.swapMarkings a.rev b.rev

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowArc_rotate
decls.doc:
The row arc of the rotated diagram is the coordinate reversal of the opposite oriented row
arc in the original diagram. The `swapMarkings` appears because `Fin.rev` reverses the cyclic
orientation.
decls.statement:
theorem rowArc_rotate (r : Fin n) :
    rowArc G.rotate r = (rowArc G.swapMarkings r.rev).image Fin.rev

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_rowArc_rotate
decls.doc:
Membership in a rotated row arc is membership of the reversed column in the opposite oriented
row arc of the original diagram.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_rowArc_rotate (r c : Fin n) :
    c ∈ rowArc G.rotate r ↔ c.rev ∈ rowArc G.swapMarkings r.rev

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.rowsNoninterleaving_rotate
decls.doc:
Row non-interleaving is preserved by half-turn rotation, with the cyclic orientation reversal
accounted for by swapping the two marking states.
decls.statement:
theorem rowsNoninterleaving_rotate (a b : Fin n) :
    RowsNoninterleaving G.rotate a b ↔ RowsNoninterleaving G.swapMarkings a.rev b.rev

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain
decls.doc:
Finitely supported coefficient functions on grid states of size `n`.

When `R` has the needed algebraic structure, this is the free module generated by those
grid states with coefficients in `R`.
decls.statement: abbrev GridChain (R : Type*) [Zero R] (n : ℕ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.relabelEquiv
decls.doc:
The linear automorphism of grid chains induced by relabeling each generator `x` along an
equivalence `e` of grid states, sending the generator `x` to the generator `e x`.

The transpose and rotation relabelings below are the two special cases in which `e` is the
permutation of grid states coming from an involution. This is an implementation helper that
factors those two equivalences; it is private because no downstream consumer refers to it.

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.relabelEquiv_single
decls.doc: The relabeling along `e` sends the generator `x` to the generator `e x`.

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.relabelEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The `y`-coefficient of a relabeled chain is the `e.symm y`-coefficient of the original
chain.

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.relabelEquiv_symm
decls.doc: The inverse of the relabeling along `e` is the relabeling along `e.symm`.

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.transposeEquiv
decls.doc:
The linear automorphism of grid chains induced by the diagonal reflection of grid states.

Because `GridState.transpose` is an involution, relabeling each generator `x` by `x.transpose`
gives a linear automorphism of the chain module `GridChain R n`.
decls.statement:
def transposeEquiv (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (n : ℕ) :
    GridChain R n ≃ₗ[R] GridChain R n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.transposeEquiv_single
decls.doc: The transpose relabeling sends the generator `x` to the generator `x.transpose`.
decls.statement:
theorem transposeEquiv_single {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} (x : GridState n) (a : R) :
    transposeEquiv R n (Finsupp.single x a) = Finsupp.single x.transpose a

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.transposeEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The `y`-coefficient of a relabeled chain is the `y.transpose`-coefficient of the original
chain.
decls.statement:
theorem transposeEquiv_apply {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} (f : GridChain R n)
    (y : GridState n) : transposeEquiv R n f y = f y.transpose

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.transposeEquiv_symm
decls.doc:
The transpose relabeling is its own inverse: since `GridState.transpose` is an involution, the
inverse automorphism is again `transposeEquiv`. This lets the forward lemmas
`transposeEquiv_single` and `transposeEquiv_apply` also drive the inverse map.
decls.statement:
theorem transposeEquiv_symm {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} :
    (transposeEquiv R n).symm = transposeEquiv R n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.rotateEquiv
decls.doc:
The linear automorphism of grid chains induced by the half-turn rotation of grid states.

Because `GridState.rotate` is an involution, relabeling each generator `x` by `x.rotate` gives a
linear automorphism of the chain module `GridChain R n`.
decls.statement:
def rotateEquiv (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (n : ℕ) :
    GridChain R n ≃ₗ[R] GridChain R n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.rotateEquiv_single
decls.doc: The rotation relabeling sends the generator `x` to the generator `x.rotate`.
decls.statement:
theorem rotateEquiv_single {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} (x : GridState n) (a : R) :
    rotateEquiv R n (Finsupp.single x a) = Finsupp.single x.rotate a

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.rotateEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The `y`-coefficient of a relabeled chain is the `y.rotate`-coefficient of the original
chain.
decls.statement:
theorem rotateEquiv_apply {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} (f : GridChain R n)
    (y : GridState n) : rotateEquiv R n f y = f y.rotate

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.rotateEquiv_symm
decls.doc:
The rotation relabeling is its own inverse: since `GridState.rotate` is an involution, the
inverse automorphism is again `rotateEquiv`. This lets the forward lemmas `rotateEquiv_single`
and `rotateEquiv_apply` also drive the inverse map.
decls.statement:
theorem rotateEquiv_symm {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} :
    (rotateEquiv R n).symm = rotateEquiv R n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator
decls.doc:
The value of the fully blocked differential on a single grid-state generator.

Its `y`-coefficient is the parity of fully blocked empty rectangles from `x` to `y`.
decls.statement: def fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator (x : GridState n) : GridChain (ZMod 2) n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_def
decls.doc:
The generator row of the fully blocked differential is the finite sum of rectangle-count
coefficients.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_def (x : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x =
      Finset.univ.sum fun y : GridState n =>
        Finsupp.single y (G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_apply
decls.doc: The `y`-coefficient of the fully blocked differential on the generator `x`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_apply (x y : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x y = G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.exists_swapColumns_of_fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_ne_zero
decls.doc:
The fully blocked differential of a generator is supported on the column transpositions of
that generator: if the `y`-coefficient is nonzero, then `y` is a column transposition of `x`.

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential
decls.doc: The fully blocked grid differential as a `ZMod 2`-linear map on chains.
decls.statement: def fullyBlockedDifferential : GridChain (ZMod 2) n →ₗ[ZMod 2] GridChain (ZMod 2) n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_single
decls.doc:
The fully blocked differential sends a single generator to the corresponding rectangle-count
row.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_single (x : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_single_apply
decls.doc:
The matrix coefficient of the fully blocked differential on a single generator is the fully
blocked rectangle count.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_single_apply (x y : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x 1) y =
      G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_apply_self
decls.doc: There is no self-term in the fully blocked differential of a generator.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_apply_self (x : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_single_apply_self
decls.doc: The self-coefficient of the fully blocked differential on a single generator is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_single_apply_self (x : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x 1) x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_apply
decls.doc:
The fully blocked differential is the finite sum of its generator rows over the support
of a chain.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_apply (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential c =
      c.sum fun x a => a • G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_apply_apply
decls.doc: The coefficient formula for the fully blocked differential on an arbitrary chain.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_apply_apply (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) (y : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential c y =
      c.sum fun x a => a * G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.map_ker_of_intertwine
decls.doc:
If a linear automorphism `e` intertwines two endomorphisms `f` and `g` pointwise
(`g (e d) = e (f d)`), it carries the kernel of `f` onto the kernel of `g`. This is the general
shape behind the cycle-symmetry statements for the fully blocked grid differential.
decls.statement:
theorem map_ker_of_intertwine (e : M ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] M) (f g : M →ₗ[ZMod 2] M)
    (h : ∀ d, g (e d) = e (f d)) :
    Submodule.map (e : M →ₗ[ZMod 2] M) (LinearMap.ker f) = LinearMap.ker g

decls.name: TauCeti.GridChain.map_range_of_intertwine
decls.doc:
If a linear automorphism `e` intertwines two endomorphisms `f` and `g` pointwise
(`g (e d) = e (f d)`), it carries the range of `f` onto the range of `g`. This is the general
shape behind the boundary-symmetry statements for the fully blocked grid differential.
decls.statement:
theorem map_range_of_intertwine (e : M ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] M) (f g : M →ₗ[ZMod 2] M)
    (h : ∀ d, g (e d) = e (f d)) :
    Submodule.map (e : M →ₗ[ZMod 2] M) (LinearMap.range f) = LinearMap.range g

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_transpose_apply
decls.doc:
The pointwise transpose intertwining of the fully blocked differentials of `G` and
`G.transpose`, extracted from `fullyBlockedDifferential_transpose`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_transpose_apply (d : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    G.transpose.fullyBlockedDifferential (GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n d) =
      GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n (G.fullyBlockedDifferential d)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_rotate_apply
decls.doc:
The pointwise rotation intertwining of the fully blocked differentials of `G` and
`G.rotate`, extracted from `fullyBlockedDifferential_rotate`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_rotate_apply (d : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    G.rotate.fullyBlockedDifferential (GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n d) =
      GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n (G.fullyBlockedDifferential d)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCycles_transpose
decls.doc:
The transpose chain relabeling carries the fully blocked cycles of `G` onto those of
`G.transpose`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCycles_transpose :
    Submodule.map (GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n : _ →ₗ[ZMod 2] _) G.fullyBlockedCycles =
      G.transpose.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries_transpose
decls.doc:
The transpose chain relabeling carries the fully blocked boundaries of `G` onto those of
`G.transpose`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundaries_transpose :
    Submodule.map (GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n : _ →ₗ[ZMod 2] _) G.fullyBlockedBoundaries =
      G.transpose.fullyBlockedBoundaries

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCycles_rotate
decls.doc:
The rotation chain relabeling carries the fully blocked cycles of `G` onto those of
`G.rotate`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCycles_rotate :
    Submodule.map (GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n : _ →ₗ[ZMod 2] _) G.fullyBlockedCycles =
      G.rotate.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries_rotate
decls.doc:
The rotation chain relabeling carries the fully blocked boundaries of `G` onto those of
`G.rotate`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundaries_rotate :
    Submodule.map (GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n : _ →ₗ[ZMod 2] _) G.fullyBlockedBoundaries =
      G.rotate.fullyBlockedBoundaries

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCycles_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
Swapping the `O` and `X` markings leaves the fully blocked cycle submodule unchanged, since
it fixes the differential.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCycles_swapMarkings :
    G.swapMarkings.fullyBlockedCycles = G.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
Swapping the `O` and `X` markings leaves the fully blocked boundary submodule unchanged, since
it fixes the differential.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundaries_swapMarkings :
    G.swapMarkings.fullyBlockedBoundaries = G.fullyBlockedBoundaries

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCyclesTransposeEquiv
decls.doc:
The diagonal reflection as a linear equivalence between the fully blocked cycles of `G` and
those of `G.transpose`.
decls.statement:
def fullyBlockedCyclesTransposeEquiv :
    G.fullyBlockedCycles ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] G.transpose.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundariesTransposeEquiv
decls.doc:
The diagonal reflection as a linear equivalence between the fully blocked boundaries of `G`
and those of `G.transpose`.
decls.statement:
def fullyBlockedBoundariesTransposeEquiv :
    G.fullyBlockedBoundaries ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] G.transpose.fullyBlockedBoundaries

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCyclesRotateEquiv
decls.doc:
The half-turn rotation as a linear equivalence between the fully blocked cycles of `G` and
those of `G.rotate`.
decls.statement:
def fullyBlockedCyclesRotateEquiv :
    G.fullyBlockedCycles ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] G.rotate.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundariesRotateEquiv
decls.doc:
The half-turn rotation as a linear equivalence between the fully blocked boundaries of `G`
and those of `G.rotate`.
decls.statement:
def fullyBlockedBoundariesRotateEquiv :
    G.fullyBlockedBoundaries ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] G.rotate.fullyBlockedBoundaries

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCyclesTransposeEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The transpose cycle equivalence acts by the underlying transpose chain relabeling.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCyclesTransposeEquiv_apply (c : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :
    (G.fullyBlockedCyclesTransposeEquiv c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) =
      GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundariesTransposeEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The transpose boundary equivalence acts by the underlying transpose chain relabeling.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundariesTransposeEquiv_apply (c : G.fullyBlockedBoundaries) :
    (G.fullyBlockedBoundariesTransposeEquiv c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) =
      GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCyclesRotateEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The rotation cycle equivalence acts by the underlying rotation chain relabeling.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCyclesRotateEquiv_apply (c : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :
    (G.fullyBlockedCyclesRotateEquiv c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) =
      GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundariesRotateEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The rotation boundary equivalence acts by the underlying rotation chain relabeling.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundariesRotateEquiv_apply (c : G.fullyBlockedBoundaries) :
    (G.fullyBlockedBoundariesRotateEquiv c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) =
      GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCycles_eq_top_of_le_two
decls.doc: In grid size at most two, every chain is a cycle for the fully blocked differential.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCycles_eq_top_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    G.fullyBlockedCycles = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries_eq_bot_of_le_two
decls.doc: In grid size at most two, the only boundary for the fully blocked differential is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundaries_eq_bot_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    G.fullyBlockedBoundaries = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedCycles_eq_top_of_two
decls.doc: On every `2 × 2` grid, every chain is a cycle for the fully blocked differential.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedCycles_eq_top_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) :
    G.fullyBlockedCycles = ⊤

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundaries_eq_bot_of_two
decls.doc: On every `2 × 2` grid, the only boundary for the fully blocked differential is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundaries_eq_bot_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) :
    G.fullyBlockedBoundaries = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedCycles_of_le_two
decls.doc: In grid size at most two, every chain is a fully blocked cycle.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedCycles_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    c ∈ G.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedBoundaries_iff_eq_zero_of_le_two
decls.doc: In grid size at most two, a fully blocked boundary is exactly the zero chain.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedBoundaries_iff_eq_zero_of_le_two
    (hn : n ≤ 2) (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    c ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries ↔ c = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedCycles_of_two
decls.doc: On every `2 × 2` grid, every chain is a fully blocked cycle.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedCycles_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) 2) :
    c ∈ G.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedBoundaries_iff_eq_zero_of_two
decls.doc: On every `2 × 2` grid, a fully blocked boundary is exactly the zero chain.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedBoundaries_iff_eq_zero_of_two
    (G : GridDiagram 2) (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) 2) :
    c ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries ↔ c = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.natCard_fullyBlockedCycles_of_le_two
decls.doc: In grid size at most two, there are `2 ^ n!` fully blocked cycles.
decls.statement:
theorem natCard_fullyBlockedCycles_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    Nat.card G.fullyBlockedCycles = 2 ^ n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.natCard_fullyBlockedBoundaries_of_le_two
decls.doc: In grid size at most two, there is one fully blocked boundary.
decls.statement:
theorem natCard_fullyBlockedBoundaries_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    Nat.card G.fullyBlockedBoundaries = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.natCard_fullyBlockedCycles_of_two
decls.doc: Every `2 × 2` grid has four fully blocked cycles.
decls.statement:
theorem natCard_fullyBlockedCycles_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) :
    Nat.card G.fullyBlockedCycles = 4

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.natCard_fullyBlockedBoundaries_of_two
decls.doc: Every `2 × 2` grid has one fully blocked boundary.
decls.statement:
theorem natCard_fullyBlockedBoundaries_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) :
    Nat.card G.fullyBlockedBoundaries = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.cIoo
decls.doc:
The clockwise open cyclic interval from `a` to `b` in `Fin n`.

If `a < b` in the standard representatives, this is the ordinary open interval
`a < x < b`. If `b ≤ a` and `a ≠ b`, it wraps around `0`, so it is the union of
`a < x` and `x < b`. The interval from a point to itself is empty.
decls.statement: def cIoo (a b : Fin n) : Finset (Fin n)

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.mem_cIoo
decls.doc:
Membership in a clockwise open cyclic interval, unfolded as inequalities between the
standard representatives.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_cIoo (a b x : Fin n) :
    x ∈ cIoo a b ↔
      a ≠ b ∧
        if a.val < b.val then
          a.val < x.val ∧ x.val < b.val
        else
          a.val < x.val ∨ x.val < b.val

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.cIoo_self
decls.doc: The open cyclic interval from a point to itself is empty.
decls.statement: theorem cIoo_self (a : Fin n) : cIoo a a = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.left_notMem_cIoo
decls.doc: The initial endpoint is not in its open cyclic interval.
decls.statement: theorem left_notMem_cIoo (a b : Fin n) : a ∉ cIoo a b

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.right_notMem_cIoo
decls.doc: The terminal endpoint is not in its open cyclic interval.
decls.statement: theorem right_notMem_cIoo (a b : Fin n) : b ∉ cIoo a b

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.Noninterleaving
decls.doc:
Two oriented cyclic intervals have non-interleaving endpoint pairs.

The endpoints `a₀`, `a₁` lie on the same side of the pair `b₀`, `b₁`, and conversely. This
two-sided formulation handles shared-endpoint cases uniformly.
decls.statement: def Noninterleaving (a₀ a₁ b₀ b₁ : Fin n) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.noninterleaving_iff
decls.doc: The defining endpoint-side conditions for `Grid.Noninterleaving`.
decls.statement:
theorem noninterleaving_iff (a₀ a₁ b₀ b₁ : Fin n) :
    Noninterleaving a₀ a₁ b₀ b₁ ↔
      (a₀ ∈ cIoo b₀ b₁ ↔ a₁ ∈ cIoo b₀ b₁) ∧
        (b₀ ∈ cIoo a₀ a₁ ↔ b₁ ∈ cIoo a₀ a₁)

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.noninterleaving_self
decls.doc: An endpoint pair is non-interleaving with itself.
decls.statement: theorem noninterleaving_self (a₀ a₁ : Fin n) : Noninterleaving a₀ a₁ a₀ a₁

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.noninterleaving_comm
decls.doc: Non-interleaving is symmetric in the two endpoint pairs.
decls.statement:
theorem noninterleaving_comm {a₀ a₁ b₀ b₁ : Fin n} :
    Noninterleaving a₀ a₁ b₀ b₁ ↔ Noninterleaving b₀ b₁ a₀ a₁

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.not_mem_cIoo_and_cIoo_swap
decls.doc:
A point cannot lie in both open cyclic intervals with the same endpoints but opposite
orientations.
decls.statement:
theorem not_mem_cIoo_and_cIoo_swap (a b x : Fin n) :
    ¬(x ∈ cIoo a b ∧ x ∈ cIoo b a)

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.disjoint_cIoo_swap
decls.doc: Opposite open cyclic intervals with the same endpoints are disjoint.
decls.statement: theorem disjoint_cIoo_swap (a b : Fin n) : Disjoint (cIoo a b) (cIoo b a)

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.mem_cIoo_or_mem_cIoo_swap_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in one of the two opposite cyclic intervals is the same as being neither
endpoint.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_cIoo_or_mem_cIoo_swap_iff {a b x : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) :
    x ∈ cIoo a b ∨ x ∈ cIoo b a ↔ x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.not_mem_cIoo_iff
decls.doc:
A point outside the clockwise interval from `a` to `b` is either an endpoint or lies in
the opposite clockwise interval.
decls.statement:
theorem not_mem_cIoo_iff {a b x : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) :
    x ∉ cIoo a b ↔ x = a ∨ x = b ∨ x ∈ cIoo b a

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.cIoo_union_swap
decls.doc: The two opposite cyclic intervals cover exactly the complement of their endpoints.
decls.statement:
theorem cIoo_union_swap {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) :
    cIoo a b ∪ cIoo b a = (Finset.univ.erase a).erase b

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.cIoo_swap_eq_erase_erase_sdiff
decls.doc: The opposite cyclic interval is the endpoint complement with the first interval removed.
decls.statement:
theorem cIoo_swap_eq_erase_erase_sdiff {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) :
    cIoo b a = (Finset.univ.erase a).erase b \ cIoo a b

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.card_cIoo_add_card_cIoo_swap
decls.doc: The two complementary cyclic intervals have total cardinality `n - 2`.
decls.statement:
theorem card_cIoo_add_card_cIoo_swap {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) :
    (cIoo a b).card + (cIoo b a).card = n - 2

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.cIoo_eq_empty_of_le_two
decls.doc:
In a grid of size at most two, every open cyclic interval is empty. There are no grid points
strictly between two endpoints on either of the two complementary arcs.
decls.statement: theorem cIoo_eq_empty_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) (a b : Fin n) : cIoo a b = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.cIoo_image_rev
decls.doc:
A clockwise open cyclic interval reversed by `Fin.rev` is the clockwise open cyclic interval
with the two endpoints reversed and exchanged.

Coordinate reversal reverses the cyclic order, so it turns the clockwise arc from `a` to `b` into
the clockwise arc from `bᵒ` to `aᵒ`.
decls.statement:
theorem cIoo_image_rev (a b : Fin n) :
    (cIoo a b).image Fin.rev = cIoo b.rev a.rev

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.mem_cIoo_rev_rev
decls.doc:
Membership in a clockwise open arc with both endpoints and the queried point reversed by
`Fin.rev`. Since coordinate reversal reverses the cyclic order, the reversed point lies in the
reversed arc exactly when the original point lies in the opposite arc.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_cIoo_rev_rev (a b x : Fin n) :
    x.rev ∈ cIoo a.rev b.rev ↔ x ∈ cIoo b a

decls.name: TauCeti.Grid.noninterleaving_rev
decls.doc:
Non-interleaving is preserved by reversing every endpoint with `Fin.rev`, with the cyclic
orientation reversal accounted for by exchanging the two endpoints within each pair.
decls.statement:
theorem noninterleaving_rev (a₀ a₁ b₀ b₁ : Fin n) :
    Noninterleaving a₀.rev a₁.rev b₀.rev b₁.rev ↔ Noninterleaving a₁ a₀ b₁ b₀

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState
decls.doc:
A grid state on an `n × n` toroidal grid.

The field `toPerm` sends each column to its occupied row. The named wrapper gives grid states
their own preferred point-set API below, while still allowing direct access to the underlying
permutation when needed.
decls.statement: structure GridState (n : ℕ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.equivPerm
decls.doc: Grid states on an `n × n` grid are equivalent to permutations of the columns.
decls.statement: def equivPerm (n : ℕ) : GridState n ≃ Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.instFintype
decls.doc: There are finitely many grid states of a fixed grid size.
decls.statement: instance : Fintype (GridState n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.instDecidableEq
decls.doc:
Equality of grid states is decidable: a grid state is determined by its underlying
permutation, whose equality is decidable. This makes finite sets of grid states computable.
decls.statement: instance : DecidableEq (GridState n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.instCoeFunForallFin
decls.doc: Apply a grid state to a column to get its occupied row.
decls.statement: instance : CoeFun (GridState n) fun _ => Fin n → Fin n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.equivPerm_apply
decls.doc: The permutation associated to a grid state by `GridState.equivPerm`.
decls.statement: theorem equivPerm_apply (x : GridState n) : equivPerm n x = x.toPerm

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.equivPerm_symm_apply
decls.doc: The grid state associated to a permutation by the inverse of `GridState.equivPerm`.
decls.statement: theorem equivPerm_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : (equivPerm n).symm σ = ⟨σ⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.equivPerm_symm_apply_apply
decls.doc: Evaluating a grid state obtained from a permutation gives the permutation value.
decls.statement:
theorem equivPerm_symm_apply_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c : Fin n) :
    ((equivPerm n).symm σ : GridState n) c = σ c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.ext
decls.doc: Grid states are extensional in their column-to-row functions.
decls.statement: theorem ext {x y : GridState n} (h : ∀ c : Fin n, x c = y c) : x = y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.pointSet
decls.doc:
The finite set of occupied squares of a grid state. The first coordinate is the column and
the second coordinate is the row.
decls.statement: def pointSet (x : GridState n) : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.equivPerm_symm_pointSet
decls.doc: The point set of the grid state obtained from `σ` is the graph `{(c, σ c)}`.
decls.statement:
theorem equivPerm_symm_pointSet (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    ((equivPerm n).symm σ : GridState n).pointSet = Finset.univ.image fun c => (c, σ c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet
decls.doc: Membership in the point set of a grid state is the graph condition for its permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet (x : GridState n) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ x.pointSet ↔ x p.1 = p.2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mk_mem_pointSet
decls.doc: The square `(c, r)` lies in a grid state's point set exactly when `x c = r`.
decls.statement:
theorem mk_mem_pointSet (x : GridState n) (c r : Fin n) :
    (c, r) ∈ x.pointSet ↔ x c = r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.card_pointSet
decls.doc: The point set of a grid state has exactly `n` occupied squares.
decls.statement: theorem card_pointSet (x : GridState n) : x.pointSet.card = n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.existsUnique_row_of_column
decls.doc: A grid state has a unique occupied row in each column.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_row_of_column (x : GridState n) (c : Fin n) :
    ∃! r : Fin n, (c, r) ∈ x.pointSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.existsUnique_column_of_row
decls.doc: A grid state has a unique occupied column in each row.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_column_of_row (x : GridState n) (r : Fin n) :
    ∃! c : Fin n, (c, r) ∈ x.pointSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnOfRow
decls.doc: The column occupied by a grid state in a given row.
decls.statement: def columnOfRow (x : GridState n) (r : Fin n) : Fin n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.apply_columnOfRow
decls.doc: The point in row `r` lies in column `columnOfRow x r`.
decls.statement: theorem apply_columnOfRow (x : GridState n) (r : Fin n) : x (x.columnOfRow r) = r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnOfRow_apply
decls.doc: The column containing the point in row `x c` is `c`.
decls.statement: theorem columnOfRow_apply (x : GridState n) (c : Fin n) : x.columnOfRow (x c) = c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.pointSet_inj
decls.doc: Point sets of grid states are equal exactly when the underlying permutations are equal.
decls.statement: theorem pointSet_inj {x y : GridState n} : x.pointSet = y.pointSet ↔ x = y

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet_inter
decls.doc:
A square lies in both state point sets exactly when both state permutations send its
column to its row.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_inter (x y : GridState n) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet ↔ x p.1 = p.2 ∧ y p.1 = p.2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.disjoint_pointSet_iff
decls.doc: Two grid states have disjoint point sets exactly when they disagree in every column.
decls.statement:
theorem disjoint_pointSet_iff (x y : GridState n) :
    Disjoint x.pointSet y.pointSet ↔ ∀ c : Fin n, x c ≠ y c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelRows
decls.doc:
Relabel the rows of a grid state by a permutation of `Fin n`.

If `ρ` is the row permutation, the point in column `c` moves from row `x c` to row
`ρ (x c)`.
decls.statement: def relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) : GridState n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelColumns
decls.doc:
Relabel the columns of a grid state by a permutation of `Fin n`.

The point in the old column `c` appears in the new column `κ c`, so the row in a new column
`c` is read from the old column `κ.symm c`.
decls.statement: def relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) : GridState n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelRows_apply
decls.doc: Row relabeling evaluates by applying the row permutation to the old row.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_apply (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) (c : Fin n) :
    x.relabelRows ρ c = ρ (x c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelColumns_apply
decls.doc: Column relabeling evaluates by reading the old state at the inverse column.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_apply (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) (c : Fin n) :
    x.relabelColumns κ c = x (κ.symm c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelRows_refl
decls.doc: Relabeling rows by the identity permutation does not change a grid state.
decls.statement: theorem relabelRows_refl (x : GridState n) : x.relabelRows (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) = x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelColumns_refl
decls.doc: Relabeling columns by the identity permutation does not change a grid state.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_refl (x : GridState n) :
    x.relabelColumns (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) = x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelRows_relabelRows
decls.doc: Successive row relabelings compose.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_relabelRows (ρ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.relabelRows ρ).relabelRows σ = x.relabelRows (ρ.trans σ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelColumns_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Successive column relabelings compose.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_relabelColumns (κ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.relabelColumns κ).relabelColumns τ = x.relabelColumns (κ.trans τ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelRows_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Row and column relabeling commute on grid states.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_relabelColumns (ρ κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.relabelRows ρ).relabelColumns κ = (x.relabelColumns κ).relabelRows ρ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet_relabelRows
decls.doc: Membership in the point set after a row relabeling.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n)
    (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ (x.relabelRows ρ).pointSet ↔ (p.1, ρ.symm p.2) ∈ x.pointSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Membership in the point set after a column relabeling.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n)
    (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ (x.relabelColumns κ).pointSet ↔ (κ.symm p.1, p.2) ∈ x.pointSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapRows
decls.doc: Swapping two rows in a grid state.
decls.statement: def swapRows (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) : GridState n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapColumns
decls.doc: Swapping two columns in a grid state.
decls.statement: def swapColumns (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) : GridState n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapRows_apply
decls.doc: Row swaps evaluate by swapping the row selected by the old state.
decls.statement:
theorem swapRows_apply (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) (c : Fin n) :
    x.swapRows a b c = Equiv.swap a b (x c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapColumns_apply
decls.doc: Column swaps evaluate by reading the old state at the swapped column.
decls.statement:
theorem swapColumns_apply (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) (c : Fin n) :
    x.swapColumns a b c = x (Equiv.swap a b c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapColumns_comm
decls.doc: Swapping columns is symmetric in the two chosen columns.
decls.statement:
theorem swapColumns_comm (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) :
    x.swapColumns a b = x.swapColumns b a

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapColumns_swapColumns
decls.doc: Swapping the same pair of columns twice is the identity on grid states.
decls.statement:
theorem swapColumns_swapColumns (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.swapColumns a b).swapColumns a b = x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnSwapNeighbors
decls.doc:
The grid states obtained from `x` by transposing a pair of distinct columns.

These are exactly the states a single grid rectangle can reach from `x`: the fully blocked
differential of the generator `x` is supported here.
decls.statement: def columnSwapNeighbors (x : GridState n) : Finset (GridState n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_columnSwapNeighbors
decls.doc:
A state is a column-swap neighbour of `x` exactly when it is `x` with a pair of distinct
columns transposed.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_columnSwapNeighbors {x y : GridState n} :
    y ∈ x.columnSwapNeighbors ↔ ∃ c d : Fin n, c ≠ d ∧ y = x.swapColumns c d

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_columnSwapNeighbors_comm
decls.doc:
If `y` is a column-swap neighbour of `x`, then `x` is a column-swap neighbour of `y`.

This is the elementary reversibility of a rectangle target: the same pair of side columns swaps
back to the source state.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_columnSwapNeighbors_comm {x y : GridState n} :
    y ∈ x.columnSwapNeighbors ↔ x ∈ y.columnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnSwapNeighbors_eq_offDiag_image
decls.doc:
The finite set of column-swap neighbours is the image of the off-diagonal of the
column set: an ordered pair of distinct columns gives the state obtained by swapping
those columns.
decls.statement:
theorem columnSwapNeighbors_eq_offDiag_image (x : GridState n) :
    x.columnSwapNeighbors =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).offDiag.image fun p => x.swapColumns p.1 p.2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.sym2_mk_eq_of_swapColumns_eq
decls.doc:
If two nontrivial column swaps of the same grid state agree, then they swap the same
unordered pair of columns.
decls.statement:
theorem sym2_mk_eq_of_swapColumns_eq {x : GridState n} {a b c d : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hcd : c ≠ d) (h : x.swapColumns a b = x.swapColumns c d) : s(a, b) = s(c, d)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.injOn_sym2_lift_swapColumns_offDiag
decls.doc:
The map from unordered off-diagonal column pairs to the state obtained by swapping those
columns is injective on the off-diagonal image.
decls.statement:
theorem injOn_sym2_lift_swapColumns_offDiag (x : GridState n) :
    Set.InjOn
      (Sym2.lift
        ⟨fun a b => x.swapColumns a b, fun a b => by
          ext c
          simp [swapColumns, Equiv.swap_comm]⟩)
      ((((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).offDiag.image Sym2.mk.uncurry) :
        Set (Sym2 (Fin n))))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.card_columnSwapNeighbors
decls.doc: A grid state has exactly `n.choose 2` column-swap neighbours.
decls.statement:
theorem card_columnSwapNeighbors (x : GridState n) :
    x.columnSwapNeighbors.card = n.choose 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.card_columnSwapNeighbors_le
decls.doc: A grid state has at most `n.choose 2` column-swap neighbours.
decls.statement:
theorem card_columnSwapNeighbors_le (x : GridState n) :
    x.columnSwapNeighbors.card ≤ n.choose 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_le_one
decls.doc: A grid state on a grid of size at most `1` has no column-swap neighbours.
decls.statement:
theorem columnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_le_one (x : GridState n) (hn : n ≤ 1) :
    x.columnSwapNeighbors = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_zero
decls.doc: A grid state on a grid of size `0` has no column-swap neighbours.
decls.statement:
theorem columnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_zero (x : GridState 0) :
    x.columnSwapNeighbors = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_one
decls.doc: A grid state on a grid of size `1` has no column-swap neighbours.
decls.statement:
theorem columnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_one (x : GridState 1) :
    x.columnSwapNeighbors = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.self_notMem_columnSwapNeighbors
decls.doc:
A grid state is not a column-swap neighbour of itself: swapping two distinct columns moves the
occupied row of either column, so the result differs from the original.
decls.statement: theorem self_notMem_columnSwapNeighbors (x : GridState n) : x ∉ x.columnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet_swapRows
decls.doc: Row swaps transport the point set by the row transposition.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_swapRows (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ (x.swapRows a b).pointSet ↔ (p.1, Equiv.swap a b p.2) ∈ x.pointSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet_swapColumns
decls.doc: Column swaps transport the point set by the column transposition.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_swapColumns (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ (x.swapColumns a b).pointSet ↔ (Equiv.swap a b p.1, p.2) ∈ x.pointSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet_inter_relabelColumns_iff
decls.doc:
A square is shared by a grid state and a column relabeling exactly when it is a
source-state square whose column is fixed by the relabeling permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_inter_relabelColumns_iff (x : GridState n) (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ x.pointSet ∩ (x.relabelColumns κ).pointSet ↔ p ∈ x.pointSet ∧ κ p.1 = p.1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapRows_swapRows
decls.doc: Swapping the same pair of rows twice is the identity on grid states.
decls.statement:
theorem swapRows_swapRows (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.swapRows a b).swapRows a b = x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet_inter_swapColumns_iff
decls.doc:
A square is shared by a grid state and the state with columns `a` and `b` swapped exactly
when it is a source-state square away from the two swapped columns.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_inter_swapColumns_iff (x : GridState n) {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b)
    (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ x.pointSet ∩ (x.swapColumns a b).pointSet ↔
      p ∈ x.pointSet ∧ p.1 ≠ a ∧ p.1 ≠ b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.pointSet_eq_insert_insert_inter_swapColumns
decls.doc:
The point set of a grid state is the shared part with a column swap, together with the two
source-state squares in the swapped columns.
decls.statement:
theorem pointSet_eq_insert_insert_inter_swapColumns (x : GridState n) {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) :
    x.pointSet =
      insert (a, x a) (insert (b, x b) (x.pointSet ∩ (x.swapColumns a b).pointSet))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapColumns_pointSet_eq_insert_insert_inter
decls.doc:
The point set after swapping columns `a` and `b` is the shared part with the source state,
together with the two target-state squares in the swapped columns.
decls.statement:
theorem swapColumns_pointSet_eq_insert_insert_inter (x : GridState n) {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) :
    (x.swapColumns a b).pointSet =
      insert (a, x b) (insert (b, x a) (x.pointSet ∩ (x.swapColumns a b).pointSet))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.card_pointSet_inter_swapColumns
decls.doc: A grid state and a swap of two distinct columns share exactly `n - 2` squares.
decls.statement:
theorem card_pointSet_inter_swapColumns (x : GridState n) {a b : Fin n} (h : a ≠ b) :
    (x.pointSet ∩ (x.swapColumns a b).pointSet).card = n - 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.transpose
decls.doc:
The diagonal reflection of a grid state.

Reflecting the occupied squares across the main diagonal exchanges columns and rows, so the new
permutation graph is the inverse of the old one.
decls.statement: def transpose (x : GridState n) : GridState n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.transpose_apply
decls.doc: The diagonal reflection evaluates by the inverse permutation graph.
decls.statement: theorem transpose_apply (x : GridState n) (c : Fin n) : x.transpose c = x.toPerm.symm c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnOfRow_eq_transpose
decls.doc: The row-to-column accessor is evaluation of the reflected grid state.
decls.statement:
theorem columnOfRow_eq_transpose (x : GridState n) (r : Fin n) :
    x.columnOfRow r = x.transpose r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnOfRow_transpose
decls.doc: The column in row `r` of the reflected state is the original row-coordinate value at `r`.
decls.statement: theorem columnOfRow_transpose (x : GridState n) (r : Fin n) : x.transpose.columnOfRow r = x r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.transpose_transpose
decls.doc: The diagonal reflection is an involution on grid states.
decls.statement: theorem transpose_transpose (x : GridState n) : x.transpose.transpose = x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelRows_transpose
decls.doc: Reflecting after a row relabeling is the same as column relabeling after reflecting.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_transpose (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.relabelRows ρ).transpose = x.transpose.relabelColumns ρ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.relabelColumns_transpose
decls.doc: Reflecting after a column relabeling is the same as row relabeling after reflecting.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_transpose (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.relabelColumns κ).transpose = x.transpose.relabelRows κ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapRows_transpose
decls.doc: Reflecting after a row swap is the same as the corresponding column swap after reflecting.
decls.statement:
theorem swapRows_transpose (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.swapRows a b).transpose = x.transpose.swapColumns a b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapColumns_transpose
decls.doc: Reflecting after a column swap is the same as the corresponding row swap after reflecting.
decls.statement:
theorem swapColumns_transpose (a b : Fin n) (x : GridState n) :
    (x.swapColumns a b).transpose = x.transpose.swapRows a b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_pointSet_transpose
decls.doc:
A square lies in the reflected state exactly when its diagonal reflection lies in the
original state.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_pointSet_transpose (x : GridState n) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ x.transpose.pointSet ↔ Prod.swap p ∈ x.pointSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.transpose_pointSet
decls.doc: The point set of the reflected state is the diagonal reflection of the original point set.
decls.statement:
theorem transpose_pointSet (x : GridState n) :
    x.transpose.pointSet = x.pointSet.image Prod.swap

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram
decls.doc:
An `n × n` grid diagram, encoded by the `O`-marking and `X`-marking permutation graphs.

The permutation fields enforce one `O` and one `X` in each row and column. The `disjoint`
field says no square contains both markings.
decls.statement: structure GridDiagram (n : ℕ)

decls.name: TauCeti.instIsEmptyGridDiagramOfNatNat
decls.doc:
There is no grid diagram of size `1`: the unique `O` and `X` markings would have to
occupy the same square.
decls.statement: instance : IsEmpty (GridDiagram 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OSet
decls.doc:
The finite set of `O` markings of a grid diagram. The first coordinate is the column and
the second coordinate is the row.
decls.statement: def OSet : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XSet
decls.doc:
The finite set of `X` markings of a grid diagram. The first coordinate is the column and
the second coordinate is the row.
decls.statement: def XSet : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_OSet
decls.doc: Membership in the `O`-marking set is the graph condition for the `O` permutation.
decls.statement: theorem mem_OSet (p : Fin n × Fin n) : p ∈ G.OSet ↔ G.O p.1 = p.2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_XSet
decls.doc: Membership in the `X`-marking set is the graph condition for the `X` permutation.
decls.statement: theorem mem_XSet (p : Fin n × Fin n) : p ∈ G.XSet ↔ G.X p.1 = p.2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mk_mem_OSet
decls.doc: The square `(c, r)` contains an `O` marking exactly when `G.O c = r`.
decls.statement: theorem mk_mem_OSet (c r : Fin n) : (c, r) ∈ G.OSet ↔ G.O c = r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mk_mem_XSet
decls.doc: The square `(c, r)` contains an `X` marking exactly when `G.X c = r`.
decls.statement: theorem mk_mem_XSet (c r : Fin n) : (c, r) ∈ G.XSet ↔ G.X c = r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.card_OSet
decls.doc: A grid diagram has exactly `n` `O` markings.
decls.statement: theorem card_OSet : G.OSet.card = n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.card_XSet
decls.doc: A grid diagram has exactly `n` `X` markings.
decls.statement: theorem card_XSet : G.XSet.card = n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.existsUnique_ORow_of_column
decls.doc: A grid diagram has a unique `O` marking in each column.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_ORow_of_column (c : Fin n) :
    ∃! r : Fin n, (c, r) ∈ G.OSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.existsUnique_XRow_of_column
decls.doc: A grid diagram has a unique `X` marking in each column.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_XRow_of_column (c : Fin n) :
    ∃! r : Fin n, (c, r) ∈ G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.existsUnique_OColumn_of_row
decls.doc: A grid diagram has a unique `O` marking in each row.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_OColumn_of_row (r : Fin n) :
    ∃! c : Fin n, (c, r) ∈ G.OSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.existsUnique_XColumn_of_row
decls.doc: A grid diagram has a unique `X` marking in each row.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_XColumn_of_row (r : Fin n) :
    ∃! c : Fin n, (c, r) ∈ G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OColumnOfRow
decls.doc: The column containing the `O` marking in a given row.
decls.statement: def OColumnOfRow (r : Fin n) : Fin n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumnOfRow
decls.doc: The column containing the `X` marking in a given row.
decls.statement: def XColumnOfRow (r : Fin n) : Fin n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OColumnOfRow_apply
decls.doc: The `O` marking in row `r` lies in column `OColumnOfRow r`.
decls.statement: theorem OColumnOfRow_apply (r : Fin n) : G.O (OColumnOfRow G r) = r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumnOfRow_apply
decls.doc: The `X` marking in row `r` lies in column `XColumnOfRow r`.
decls.statement: theorem XColumnOfRow_apply (r : Fin n) : G.X (XColumnOfRow G r) = r
