decls.doc: The column containing the `O` marking in row `G.O c` is `c`.
decls.statement: theorem OColumnOfRow_O (c : Fin n) : OColumnOfRow G (G.O c) = c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumnOfRow_X
decls.doc: The column containing the `X` marking in row `G.X c` is `c`.
decls.statement: theorem XColumnOfRow_X (c : Fin n) : XColumnOfRow G (G.X c) = c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.disjoint_OSet_XSet
decls.doc: The `O` and `X` marking sets of a grid diagram are disjoint.
decls.statement: theorem disjoint_OSet_XSet : Disjoint G.OSet G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.not_mem_OSet_and_mem_XSet
decls.doc: No square contains both an `O` marking and an `X` marking.
decls.statement: theorem not_mem_OSet_and_mem_XSet (p : Fin n × Fin n) : ¬ (p ∈ G.OSet ∧ p ∈ G.XSet)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.not_mem_XSet_of_mem_OSet
decls.doc: A square with an `O` marking does not contain an `X` marking.
decls.statement: theorem not_mem_XSet_of_mem_OSet {p : Fin n × Fin n} (hp : p ∈ G.OSet) : p ∉ G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.not_mem_OSet_of_mem_XSet
decls.doc: A square with an `X` marking does not contain an `O` marking.
decls.statement: theorem not_mem_OSet_of_mem_XSet {p : Fin n × Fin n} (hp : p ∈ G.XSet) : p ∉ G.OSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.relabelRows
decls.doc: Relabel the rows of a grid diagram by relabeling both marking states.
decls.statement: def relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (G : GridDiagram n) : GridDiagram n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.relabelColumns
decls.doc: Relabel the columns of a grid diagram by relabeling both marking states.
decls.statement: def relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (G : GridDiagram n) : GridDiagram n

decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_O (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).O = G.O.relabelRows ρ

decls.doc: The `X` marking state of a row-relabelled grid diagram.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_X (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).X = G.X.relabelRows ρ

decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_O (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).O = G.O.relabelColumns κ

decls.doc: The `X` marking state of a column-relabelled grid diagram.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_X (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).X = G.X.relabelColumns κ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.relabelRows_O_apply
decls.doc: Row relabeling evaluates on the `O` marking by applying the row permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_O_apply (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c : Fin n) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).O c = ρ (G.O c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.relabelRows_X_apply
decls.doc: Row relabeling evaluates on the `X` marking by applying the row permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_X_apply (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c : Fin n) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).X c = ρ (G.X c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.relabelColumns_O_apply
decls.doc: Column relabeling evaluates on the `O` marking at the inverse old column.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_O_apply (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c : Fin n) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).O c = G.O (κ.symm c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.relabelColumns_X_apply
decls.doc: Column relabeling evaluates on the `X` marking at the inverse old column.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_X_apply (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (c : Fin n) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).X c = G.X (κ.symm c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_OSet_relabelRows
decls.doc: Row relabeling transports the `O` marking set by the row permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_OSet_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ (G.relabelRows ρ).OSet ↔ (p.1, ρ.symm p.2) ∈ G.OSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_XSet_relabelRows
decls.doc: Row relabeling transports the `X` marking set by the row permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_XSet_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ (G.relabelRows ρ).XSet ↔ (p.1, ρ.symm p.2) ∈ G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_OSet_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Column relabeling transports the `O` marking set by the column permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_OSet_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ (G.relabelColumns κ).OSet ↔ (κ.symm p.1, p.2) ∈ G.OSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_XSet_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Column relabeling transports the `X` marking set by the column permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_XSet_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ (G.relabelColumns κ).XSet ↔ (κ.symm p.1, p.2) ∈ G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.transpose_transpose

theorem swapRows_transpose (a b : Fin n) :

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapColumns_transpose

theorem swapColumns_transpose (a b : Fin n) :
    (G.swapColumns a b).transpose = G.transpose.swapRows a b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.transpose_OSet
decls.doc:
The `O`-marking set of the reflected diagram is the diagonal reflection of the original
`O`-marking set.

`X`-marking set.

decls.doc:
A square lies in the reflected diagram's `O`-marking set exactly when its diagonal

theorem mem_OSet_transpose (p : Fin n × Fin n) :

decls.doc:
A square lies in the reflected diagram's `X`-marking set exactly when its diagonal
reflection lies in the original `X`-marking set.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_XSet_transpose (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ G.transpose.XSet ↔ Prod.swap p ∈ G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapMarkings
decls.doc:
The marking swap of a grid diagram, obtained by exchanging the `O`- and `X`-marking states.

The defining no-double-marking condition is symmetric in the two marking states, so the swap is
again a grid diagram.
decls.statement: def swapMarkings (G : GridDiagram n) : GridDiagram n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapMarkings_O
decls.doc: The `O`-marking state of the marking swap is the original `X`-marking state.
decls.statement: theorem swapMarkings_O : G.swapMarkings.O = G.X

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapMarkings_X
decls.doc: The `X`-marking state of the marking swap is the original `O`-marking state.
decls.statement: theorem swapMarkings_X : G.swapMarkings.X = G.O

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OColumnOfRow_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Swapping markings changes the `O` row lookup to the original `X` row lookup.
decls.statement:
theorem OColumnOfRow_swapMarkings (r : Fin n) :
    OColumnOfRow G.swapMarkings r = XColumnOfRow G r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumnOfRow_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Swapping markings changes the `X` row lookup to the original `O` row lookup.
decls.statement:
theorem XColumnOfRow_swapMarkings (r : Fin n) :
    XColumnOfRow G.swapMarkings r = OColumnOfRow G r

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapMarkings_OSet
decls.doc: The `O`-marking set of the marking swap is the original `X`-marking set.
decls.statement: theorem swapMarkings_OSet : G.swapMarkings.OSet = G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapMarkings_XSet
decls.doc: The `X`-marking set of the marking swap is the original `O`-marking set.
decls.statement: theorem swapMarkings_XSet : G.swapMarkings.XSet = G.OSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_OSet_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
Membership in the marking swap's `O`-marking set is membership in the original
`X`-marking set.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_OSet_swapMarkings (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ G.swapMarkings.OSet ↔ p ∈ G.XSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_XSet_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
Membership in the marking swap's `X`-marking set is membership in the original
`O`-marking set.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_XSet_swapMarkings (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ G.swapMarkings.XSet ↔ p ∈ G.OSet

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapMarkings_swapMarkings
decls.doc: The marking swap is an involution.
decls.statement: theorem swapMarkings_swapMarkings : G.swapMarkings.swapMarkings = G

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.relabelRows_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Row relabeling commutes with exchanging the two marking states.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelRows_swapMarkings (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).swapMarkings = G.swapMarkings.relabelRows ρ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.relabelColumns_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Column relabeling commutes with exchanging the two marking states.
decls.statement:
theorem relabelColumns_swapMarkings (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).swapMarkings = G.swapMarkings.relabelColumns κ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapRows_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Row swaps commute with exchanging the two marking states.
decls.statement:
theorem swapRows_swapMarkings (a b : Fin n) :
    (G.swapRows a b).swapMarkings = G.swapMarkings.swapRows a b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapColumns_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Column swaps commute with exchanging the two marking states.
decls.statement:
theorem swapColumns_swapMarkings (a b : Fin n) :
    (G.swapColumns a b).swapMarkings = G.swapMarkings.swapColumns a b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.swapMarkings_transpose
decls.doc: The marking swap commutes with the diagonal reflection of a grid diagram.
decls.statement: theorem swapMarkings_transpose : G.swapMarkings.transpose = G.transpose.swapMarkings

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentPerm
decls.doc:
The permutation of `O`-marking columns obtained by traversing one horizontal segment from
`O` to `X`, then the vertical segment back to `O`.

Thus `componentPerm G c = XColumnOfRow G (G.O c)`. Its permutation cycles are the components of
the oriented link represented by `G`.
decls.statement: def componentPerm : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentPerm_def
decls.doc:
The component permutation is the `O`-marking permutation followed by the inverse of the
`X`-marking permutation. Downstream modules use this defining formula to read off the component
permutation of a diagram whose two marking permutations are known.
decls.statement: theorem componentPerm_def : G.componentPerm = G.X.toPerm⁻¹ * G.O.toPerm

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentPerm_apply
decls.doc:
Applying the component permutation follows the `O`-marking's row to its unique
`X`-marking column.
decls.statement:
theorem componentPerm_apply (c : Fin n) :
    G.componentPerm c = XColumnOfRow G (G.O c)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentPerm_apply_ne_self
decls.doc:
The component permutation has no fixed columns, because an `O` and an `X` cannot occupy the
same square.
decls.statement: theorem componentPerm_apply_ne_self (c : Fin n) : G.componentPerm c ≠ c

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.support_componentPerm
decls.doc: Every column belongs to the support of the component permutation.
decls.statement: theorem support_componentPerm : G.componentPerm.support = Finset.univ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycles
decls.doc:
The cycle factors of the component permutation. Each factor is one component of the
represented link, expressed as a cyclic permutation of its `O`-marking columns.
decls.statement: def componentCycles : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_componentCycles_iff
decls.doc:
A permutation is a component cycle exactly when it is a cycle agreeing with the component
permutation throughout its support.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_componentCycles_iff (c : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    c ∈ G.componentCycles ↔
      c.IsCycle ∧ ∀ a ∈ c.support, c a = G.componentPerm a

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycleType
decls.doc: The multiset of component sizes of the link represented by a grid diagram.
decls.statement: def componentCycleType : Multiset ℕ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycleType_def
decls.doc: The component-size multiset is the cycle type of the component permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCycleType_def :
    G.componentCycleType = G.componentPerm.cycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount
decls.doc: The number of components of the link represented by a grid diagram.
decls.statement: def componentCount : ℕ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount_def
decls.doc: The component count is the cardinality of the component-size multiset.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCount_def :
    G.componentCount = G.componentCycleType.card

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.card_componentCycles
decls.doc: The number of component cycles agrees with `componentCount`.
decls.statement: theorem card_componentCycles : G.componentCycles.card = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.sum_componentCycleType
decls.doc: The component sizes sum to the grid size: every marking belongs to exactly one component.
decls.statement: theorem sum_componentCycleType : G.componentCycleType.sum = n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot
decls.doc: A grid diagram represents a knot when its component permutation has exactly one cycle.
decls.statement: def IsKnot : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isKnot_def
decls.doc: A grid diagram is a knot diagram exactly when its component count is one.
decls.statement: theorem isKnot_def : G.IsKnot ↔ G.componentCount = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isKnot_iff_componentPerm_isCycle
decls.doc:
A grid diagram represents a knot exactly when its component permutation is a single
nontrivial cycle.
decls.statement:
theorem isKnot_iff_componentPerm_isCycle :
    G.IsKnot ↔ G.componentPerm.IsCycle

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.componentCycleType_eq
decls.doc: The sole component of a knot grid contains all `n` markings.
decls.statement:
theorem IsKnot.componentCycleType_eq (hG : G.IsKnot) :
    G.componentCycleType = {n}

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc: A grid diagram has no link components exactly when its size is zero.
decls.statement: theorem componentCount_eq_zero_iff : G.componentCount = 0 ↔ n = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount_eq_zero_of_zero
decls.doc: The empty grid has no link components.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCount_eq_zero_of_zero (G : GridDiagram 0) :
    G.componentCount = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.not_isKnot_of_zero
decls.doc: An empty grid does not represent a knot.
decls.statement: theorem not_isKnot_of_zero (G : GridDiagram 0) : ¬G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isKnot_of_two
decls.doc:
Every `2 × 2` grid diagram represents a knot. Its fixed-point-free component permutation is
the transposition of the two columns.
decls.statement: theorem isKnot_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) : G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentPerm_relabelRows
decls.doc:
Relabeling rows does not change the component permutation: the common row relabeling cancels
between the `O`- and `X`-marking permutations.
decls.statement:
theorem componentPerm_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).componentPerm = G.componentPerm

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentPerm_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Relabeling columns conjugates the component permutation by the column relabeling.
decls.statement:
theorem componentPerm_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).componentPerm =
      κ * G.componentPerm * κ⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycles_relabelRows
decls.doc: Row relabeling preserves the component cycles.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCycles_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).componentCycles = G.componentCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_componentCycles_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Column relabeling transports component cycles by conjugation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_componentCycles_relabelColumns (κ c : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    κ * c * κ⁻¹ ∈ (G.relabelColumns κ).componentCycles ↔
      c ∈ G.componentCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycleType_relabelRows
decls.doc: Row relabeling preserves the component-size multiset.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCycleType_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).componentCycleType = G.componentCycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycleType_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Column relabeling preserves the component-size multiset.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCycleType_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).componentCycleType = G.componentCycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentPerm_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Exchanging the `O`- and `X`-markings inverts the component permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem componentPerm_swapMarkings :
    G.swapMarkings.componentPerm = G.componentPerm⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_componentCycles_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Exchanging the marking types reverses every component cycle.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_componentCycles_swapMarkings (c : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    c⁻¹ ∈ G.swapMarkings.componentCycles ↔ c ∈ G.componentCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycleType_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Exchanging the two marking types preserves the component-size multiset.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCycleType_swapMarkings :
    G.swapMarkings.componentCycleType = G.componentCycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentPerm_transpose
decls.doc:
Diagonal reflection conjugates the inverse component permutation by the `X`-marking
permutation.
decls.statement:
theorem componentPerm_transpose :
  G.transpose.componentPerm =
      G.X.toPerm * G.componentPerm⁻¹ * G.X.toPerm⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_componentCycles_transpose
decls.doc: Diagonal reflection transports component cycles by inversion and conjugation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_componentCycles_transpose (c : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    G.X.toPerm * c⁻¹ * G.X.toPerm⁻¹ ∈ G.transpose.componentCycles ↔
      c ∈ G.componentCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycleType_transpose
decls.doc: Diagonal reflection preserves the component-size multiset.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCycleType_transpose :
    G.transpose.componentCycleType = G.componentCycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_componentCycles_rotate
decls.doc: Half-turn rotation transports component cycles by coordinate-reversal conjugation.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_componentCycles_rotate (c : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    Fin.revPerm * c * Fin.revPerm⁻¹ ∈ G.rotate.componentCycles ↔
      c ∈ G.componentCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCycleType_rotate
decls.doc: Half-turn rotation preserves the component-size multiset.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCycleType_rotate :
    G.rotate.componentCycleType = G.componentCycleType

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount_relabelRows
decls.doc: Row relabeling preserves the number of represented link components.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCount_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).componentCount = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Column relabeling preserves the number of represented link components.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCount_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).componentCount = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount_transpose
decls.doc: Diagonal reflection preserves the number of represented link components.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCount_transpose :
    G.transpose.componentCount = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount_rotate
decls.doc: Half-turn rotation preserves the number of represented link components.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCount_rotate :
    G.rotate.componentCount = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.componentCount_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Exchanging the two marking types preserves the number of represented link components.
decls.statement:
theorem componentCount_swapMarkings :
    G.swapMarkings.componentCount = G.componentCount

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isKnot_relabelRows
decls.doc: Row relabeling preserves whether a grid diagram represents a knot.
decls.statement:
theorem isKnot_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelRows ρ).IsKnot ↔ G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isKnot_relabelColumns
decls.doc: Column relabeling preserves whether a grid diagram represents a knot.
decls.statement:
theorem isKnot_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (G.relabelColumns κ).IsKnot ↔ G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isKnot_transpose
decls.doc: Diagonal reflection preserves whether a grid diagram represents a knot.
decls.statement: theorem isKnot_transpose : G.transpose.IsKnot ↔ G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isKnot_rotate
decls.doc: Half-turn rotation preserves whether a grid diagram represents a knot.
decls.statement: theorem isKnot_rotate : G.rotate.IsKnot ↔ G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isKnot_swapMarkings
decls.doc: Exchanging the two marking types preserves whether a grid diagram represents a knot.
decls.statement: theorem isKnot_swapMarkings : G.swapMarkings.IsKnot ↔ G.IsKnot

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnOfRow_relabelRows
decls.doc:
Row relabeling moves the column containing a given row by reading the old state at the
inverse row label.
decls.statement:
theorem columnOfRow_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r : Fin n) :
    (x.relabelRows ρ).columnOfRow r = x.columnOfRow (ρ.symm r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnOfRow_relabelColumns
decls.doc:
Column relabeling moves the column containing a given row by applying the column permutation
to the old column.
decls.statement:
theorem columnOfRow_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r : Fin n) :
    (x.relabelColumns κ).columnOfRow r = κ (x.columnOfRow r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnOfRow_swapRows
decls.doc:
After swapping rows, the column containing row `r` is the old column containing the swapped
row label.
decls.statement:
theorem columnOfRow_swapRows (a b r : Fin n) :
    (x.swapRows a b).columnOfRow r = x.columnOfRow (Equiv.swap a b r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.columnOfRow_swapColumns
decls.doc:
After swapping columns, the column containing row `r` is the swap of the old column
containing that row.
decls.statement:
theorem columnOfRow_swapColumns (a b r : Fin n) :
    (x.swapColumns a b).columnOfRow r = Equiv.swap a b (x.columnOfRow r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OColumnOfRow_relabelRows
decls.doc:
Row relabeling moves the `O` column lookup by reading the old diagram at the inverse row
label.
decls.statement:
theorem OColumnOfRow_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r : Fin n) :
    OColumnOfRow (G.relabelRows ρ) r = OColumnOfRow G (ρ.symm r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumnOfRow_relabelRows
decls.doc:
Row relabeling moves the `X` column lookup by reading the old diagram at the inverse row
label.
decls.statement:
theorem XColumnOfRow_relabelRows (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r : Fin n) :
    XColumnOfRow (G.relabelRows ρ) r = XColumnOfRow G (ρ.symm r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OColumnOfRow_relabelColumns
decls.doc:
Column relabeling moves the `O` column lookup by applying the column permutation to the old
lookup.
decls.statement:
theorem OColumnOfRow_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r : Fin n) :
    OColumnOfRow (G.relabelColumns κ) r = κ (OColumnOfRow G r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumnOfRow_relabelColumns
decls.doc:
Column relabeling moves the `X` column lookup by applying the column permutation to the old
lookup.
decls.statement:
theorem XColumnOfRow_relabelColumns (κ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r : Fin n) :
    XColumnOfRow (G.relabelColumns κ) r = κ (XColumnOfRow G r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OColumnOfRow_swapRows
decls.doc:
After swapping rows, the `O` marking in row `r` lies in the old `O` column for the swapped
row label.
decls.statement:
theorem OColumnOfRow_swapRows (a b r : Fin n) :
    OColumnOfRow (G.swapRows a b) r = OColumnOfRow G (Equiv.swap a b r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumnOfRow_swapRows
decls.doc:
After swapping rows, the `X` marking in row `r` lies in the old `X` column for the swapped
row label.
decls.statement:
theorem XColumnOfRow_swapRows (a b r : Fin n) :
    XColumnOfRow (G.swapRows a b) r = XColumnOfRow G (Equiv.swap a b r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.OColumnOfRow_swapColumns
decls.doc: After swapping columns, the `O` marking in row `r` lies in the swapped old `O` column.
decls.statement:
theorem OColumnOfRow_swapColumns (a b r : Fin n) :
    OColumnOfRow (G.swapColumns a b) r = Equiv.swap a b (OColumnOfRow G r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XColumnOfRow_swapColumns
decls.doc: After swapping columns, the `X` marking in row `r` lies in the swapped old `X` column.
decls.statement:
theorem XColumnOfRow_swapColumns (a b r : Fin n) :
    XColumnOfRow (G.swapColumns a b) r = Equiv.swap a b (XColumnOfRow G r)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.self_mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_of_ne
decls.doc:
Swapping a distinct pair of columns and then swapping the same pair back puts the source state
in its own two-step column-swap neighbour set.
decls.statement:
theorem self_mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_of_ne (x : GridState n) {a b : Fin n}
    (hab : a ≠ b) : x ∈ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.sym2_mk_eq_of_swapColumns_swapColumns_eq_self
decls.doc: A diagonal two-step column-swap witness must swap the same unordered pair of columns twice.

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.swapColumns_swapColumns_eq_self_iff_sym2_mk_eq
decls.doc:
Two nontrivial column swaps form a diagonal two-step witness exactly when they use the same
unordered pair of columns.

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.self_mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_iff_exists_pair_ne
decls.doc:
The source state appears in its own two-step neighbour set exactly when there is a distinct
pair of grid columns.
decls.statement:
theorem self_mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_iff_exists_pair_ne (x : GridState n) :
    x ∈ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors ↔ ∃ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.self_mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_of_two_le
decls.doc: If the grid has at least two columns, the source state is a two-step neighbour of itself.
decls.statement:
theorem self_mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_of_two_le (x : GridState n) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    x ∈ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.self_mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_iff_two_le
decls.doc: The source state is a two-step neighbour of itself exactly in grid size at least two.
decls.statement:
theorem self_mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_iff_two_le (x : GridState n) :
    x ∈ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors ↔ 2 ≤ n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_apply
decls.doc:
The coefficient of `∂ (∂ x)` at `z` is the finite sum over all intermediate grid states
`y` of the product of the two rectangle-count coefficients. This is the matrix multiplication
formula for the fully blocked differential.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_apply (x z : GridState n) :
    (Finsupp.sum (G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x) fun y a =>
        a * G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount y z) =
      ∑ y : GridState n, G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y *
        G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount y z

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.sum_fullyBlockedRectangleCount_mul_eq_zero_of_notMem_twoStep
decls.doc:
If `z` is not reachable from `x` by two column swaps, the length-two rectangle-count sum
from `x` to `z` vanishes.
decls.statement:
theorem sum_fullyBlockedRectangleCount_mul_eq_zero_of_notMem_twoStep
    (x : GridState n) {z : GridState n} (hz : z ∉ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors) :
    (∑ y : GridState n, G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y *
      G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount y z) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc:
The square of the fully blocked differential vanishes on a generator exactly when every
length-two rectangle-count coefficient sum out of that generator vanishes.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_eq_zero_iff (x : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential
        (G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x (1 : ZMod 2))) = 0 ↔
      ∀ z : GridState n,
        (∑ y : GridState n, G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y *
          G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount y z) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_comp_self_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc:
The global square-zero statement for the fully blocked differential is equivalent to
vanishing of every length-two rectangle-count coefficient sum.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_comp_self_eq_zero_iff :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential.comp G.fullyBlockedDifferential = 0 ↔
      ∀ x z : GridState n,
        (∑ y : GridState n, G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y *
          G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount y z) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors
decls.doc:
The grid states reachable from `x` by two nontrivial column transpositions.

This is the finite ambient set for the support of `∂ (∂ x)` before the rectangle-pairing
argument proves that all of its coefficients cancel.
decls.statement: def twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors (x : GridState n) : Finset (GridState n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors
decls.doc: Membership in the two-step column-swap neighbour set.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors {x z : GridState n} :
    z ∈ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors ↔
      ∃ y : GridState n, y ∈ x.columnSwapNeighbors ∧ z ∈ y.columnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_iff_exists_swaps
decls.doc: An expanded membership form for the two-step column-swap neighbour set.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_iff_exists_swaps {x z : GridState n} :
    z ∈ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors ↔
      ∃ y : GridState n, ∃ a b c d : Fin n,
        a ≠ b ∧ c ≠ d ∧ y = x.swapColumns a b ∧ z = y.swapColumns c d

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.card_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_le
decls.doc: The two-step neighbour set has at most `(n.choose 2) ^ 2` states.
decls.statement:
theorem card_twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_le (x : GridState n) :
    x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors.card ≤ (n.choose 2) ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_le_one
decls.doc: In grid size at most `1`, no state is reachable by two nontrivial column swaps.
decls.statement:
theorem twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_le_one (x : GridState n) (hn : n ≤ 1) :
    x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_zero
decls.doc: In grid size `0`, no state is reachable by two nontrivial column swaps.
decls.statement:
theorem twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_zero (x : GridState 0) :
    x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridState.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_one
decls.doc: In grid size `1`, no state is reachable by two nontrivial column swaps.
decls.statement:
theorem twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors_eq_empty_of_one (x : GridState 1) :
    x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_support_subset_biUnion
decls.doc:
The support of `∂ (∂ c)` is contained in the union of the two-step neighbour sets attached
to the states appearing in the input chain.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_support_subset_biUnion (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferential (G.fullyBlockedDifferential c)).support ⊆
      c.support.biUnion fun x : GridState n => x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_support_biUnion
decls.doc:
If a state is not in any two-step neighbour set attached to the input support, its
coefficient in `∂ (∂ c)` is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_support_biUnion
    (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) {z : GridState n}
    (hz : z ∉ c.support.biUnion fun x : GridState n => x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential (G.fullyBlockedDifferential c) z = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_support_card_le
decls.doc:
The support of `∂ (∂ c)` has cardinality at most
`c.support.card * (n.choose 2) ^ 2`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_support_card_le (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferential (G.fullyBlockedDifferential c)).support.card ≤
      c.support.card * (n.choose 2) ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_support_subset
decls.doc:
The support of `∂ (∂ x)` is contained in the states reachable from `x` by two
column transpositions. This is the finite search space for the later rectangle-pairing proof of
`∂² = 0` on generators.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_support_subset (x : GridState n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferential
      (G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x 1))).support ⊆
        x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_twoStep
decls.doc:
If a state is not reachable by two column swaps from `x`, its coefficient in
`∂ (∂ x)` is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_twoStep
    (x : GridState n) {z : GridState n} (hz : z ∉ x.twoStepColumnSwapNeighbors) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential
      (G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x 1)) z = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_support_card_le
decls.doc: The support of `∂ (∂ x)` has at most `(n.choose 2) ^ 2` states.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_support_card_le (x : GridState n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferential
      (G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x 1))).support.card ≤
        (n.choose 2) ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangles_nonempty_of_count_ne_zero
decls.doc:
A nonzero fully blocked rectangle count produces an oriented rectangle, hence at least one
fully blocked rectangle exists between the two states.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangles_nonempty_of_count_ne_zero
    (h : G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y ≠ 0) : (G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y).Nonempty

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangleCount_eq_zero_of_forall_ne
decls.doc:
The fully blocked rectangle count vanishes whenever the target is not any column transposition
of the source. This is the contrapositive of
`exists_swapColumns_of_fullyBlockedRectangleCount_ne_zero`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangleCount_eq_zero_of_forall_ne
    (h : ∀ c d : Fin n, c ≠ d → y ≠ x.swapColumns c d) :
    G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedRectangleCount_eq_zero_of_notMem_columnSwapNeighbors
decls.doc:
The fully blocked rectangle count is supported on column transpositions: if `y` is not a
column-swap neighbour of `x`, the coefficient is zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedRectangleCount_eq_zero_of_notMem_columnSwapNeighbors
    (h : y ∉ x.columnSwapNeighbors) : G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_columnSwapNeighbors
decls.doc:
The coefficient of the fully blocked differential on a generator vanishes off the column-swap
neighbours of the state.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_columnSwapNeighbors
    (x : GridState n) {y : GridState n} (h : y ∉ x.columnSwapNeighbors) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x y = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_subset
decls.doc:
The fully blocked differential of a generator `x` is supported on the column-swap neighbours
of `x`: although there are `n!` grid states, `∂ x` only reaches the states obtained by
transposing a pair of columns.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_subset (x : GridState n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x).support ⊆ x.columnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_card_le
decls.doc:
The number of states reached by the fully blocked differential of a generator is at most the
number of column-swap neighbours of the state.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_card_le (x : GridState n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x).support.card ≤ x.columnSwapNeighbors.card

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_single_support_subset
decls.doc:
The fully blocked differential of a single generator, taken through the linear map, is
supported on the column-swap neighbours of the state.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_single_support_subset (x : GridState n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferential (Finsupp.single x 1)).support ⊆ x.columnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_card_le_choose
decls.doc:
The support of the fully blocked differential of one generator has at most
`n.choose 2` states. This is the quantitative form of the column-transposition
support theorem.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_card_le_choose (x : GridState n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x).support.card ≤ n.choose 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_eq_empty_of_le_one
decls.doc:
The support of the fully blocked differential of one generator is empty in grid
size at most `1`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_eq_empty_of_le_one
    (G : GridDiagram n) (hn : n ≤ 1) (x : GridState n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x).support = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_eq_empty_of_zero
decls.doc:
The support of the fully blocked differential of one generator is empty in grid
size `0`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_support_eq_empty_of_zero (G : GridDiagram 0)
    (x : GridState 0) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x).support = ∅

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_eq_zero_of_le_one
decls.doc: The fully blocked differential of a generator is zero in grid size at most `1`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_eq_zero_of_le_one
    (G : GridDiagram n) (hn : n ≤ 1) (x : GridState n) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_eq_zero_of_zero
decls.doc: The fully blocked differential of a generator is zero in grid size `0`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_eq_zero_of_zero (G : GridDiagram 0)
    (x : GridState 0) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_support_subset_biUnion
decls.doc:
The support of the fully blocked differential of a chain is contained in the union
of the column-swap neighbour sets of the states appearing in the input chain.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_support_subset_biUnion (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferential c).support ⊆
      c.support.biUnion fun x : GridState n => x.columnSwapNeighbors

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_support_biUnion
decls.doc:
A coefficient of the fully blocked differential vanishes if its target is not in the
union of column-swap neighbours of the input support.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem_support_biUnion
    (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) {y : GridState n}
    (h : y ∉ c.support.biUnion fun x : GridState n => x.columnSwapNeighbors) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential c y = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_support_card_le
decls.doc:
The support of the fully blocked differential of an arbitrary chain has cardinality
at most the size of the input support times `n.choose 2`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_support_card_le (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) :
    (G.fullyBlockedDifferential c).support.card ≤ c.support.card * n.choose 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero_of_le_one
decls.doc: The fully blocked differential is zero on every chain in grid size at most `1`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero_of_le_one (G : GridDiagram n) (hn : n ≤ 1) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential = (0 : GridChain (ZMod 2) n →ₗ[ZMod 2] GridChain (ZMod 2) n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero_of_zero
decls.doc: The fully blocked differential is zero on every chain in grid size `0`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_eq_zero_of_zero (G : GridDiagram 0) :
    G.fullyBlockedDifferential = (0 : GridChain (ZMod 2) 0 →ₗ[ZMod 2] GridChain (ZMod 2) 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
The generator row of the fully blocked differential is invariant under swapping the `O` and
`X` markings.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_swapMarkings (x : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x =
      G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
The whole fully blocked grid differential is invariant under swapping the `O` and `X`
markings.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_swapMarkings :
    G.swapMarkings.fullyBlockedDifferential = G.fullyBlockedDifferential

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_transpose
decls.doc:
The generator row of the fully blocked differential intertwines the diagonal reflection: the
reflected diagram's row on `x.transpose` is the transpose relabeling of the original row on `x`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_transpose (x : GridState n) :
    G.transpose.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x.transpose =
      GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n (G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_transpose
decls.doc:
The fully blocked grid differential commutes with the transpose chain relabeling, intertwining
the differentials of `G` and `G.transpose`. This is the chain-level form of the statement that the
diagonal reflection is a symmetry of the fully blocked grid complex.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_transpose :
    G.transpose.fullyBlockedDifferential ∘ₗ (GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n).toLinearMap =
      (GridChain.transposeEquiv (ZMod 2) n).toLinearMap ∘ₗ G.fullyBlockedDifferential

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_rotate
decls.doc:
The generator row of the fully blocked differential intertwines the half-turn rotation: the
rotated diagram's row on `x.rotate` is the rotation relabeling of the original row on `x`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator_rotate (x : GridState n) :
    G.rotate.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x.rotate =
      GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n (G.fullyBlockedDifferentialOnGenerator x)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDifferential_rotate
decls.doc:
The fully blocked grid differential commutes with the rotation chain relabeling, intertwining
the differentials of `G` and `G.rotate`. This is the chain-level form of the statement that the
half-turn rotation is a symmetry of the fully blocked grid complex.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedDifferential_rotate :
    G.rotate.fullyBlockedDifferential ∘ₗ (GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n).toLinearMap =
      (GridChain.rotateEquiv (ZMod 2) n).toLinearMap ∘ₗ G.fullyBlockedDifferential

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_insert_pair_left
decls.doc:
Splitting a two-point insertion out of the left argument of the `J`-function. The two fresh
points contribute their singleton pairings and the rest is untouched; this is the bookkeeping a
corner-localized grading-change computation rests on.
decls.statement:
theorem J_insert_pair_left {S P : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} {a b : Fin n × Fin n}
    (hab : a ∉ insert b S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    GridPoint.J (insert a (insert b S)) P =
      GridPoint.J {a} P + GridPoint.J {b} P + GridPoint.J S P

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_insert_pair_right
decls.doc: Splitting a two-point insertion out of the right argument of the `J`-function.
decls.statement:
theorem J_insert_pair_right {S P : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} {a b : Fin n × Fin n}
    (hab : a ∉ insert b S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    GridPoint.J P (insert a (insert b S)) =
      GridPoint.J P {a} + GridPoint.J P {b} + GridPoint.J P S

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_insert_pair_self
decls.doc:
The self-pairing of a point set after inserting two fresh points. The singleton self-terms
vanish, leaving the pair contribution, the two pairings with the old set, and the old
self-pairing.
decls.statement:
theorem J_insert_pair_self {S : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} {a b : Fin n × Fin n}
    (hab : a ∉ insert b S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    GridPoint.J (insert a (insert b S)) (insert a (insert b S)) =
      2 * (GridPoint.J {a} {b} + GridPoint.J {a} S + GridPoint.J {b} S) +
        GridPoint.J S S

decls.name: TauCeti.GridRectangleBetween.left_bottom_notMem_insert_inter
decls.doc:
The source corner `(left, bottom)` is distinct from the other source corner `(right, top)`
and avoids the shared part of the two states, so it does not lie in their insertion.
decls.statement:
theorem left_bottom_notMem_insert_inter :
    (R.left, R.bottom) ∉ insert (R.right, R.top) (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridRectangleBetween.left_top_notMem_insert_inter
decls.doc:
The target corner `(left, top)` is distinct from the other target corner `(right, bottom)`
and avoids the shared part of the two states, so it does not lie in their insertion.
decls.statement:
theorem left_top_notMem_insert_inter :
    (R.left, R.top) ∉ insert (R.right, R.bottom) (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridRectangleBetween.J_self_sub_J_self_eq
decls.doc:
Across a rectangle move, the change in the state self-pairing is localized to the four
moving corners and their pairings with the shared part of the two states. This removes the
opaque `GridState.J x x - GridState.J y y` term from the Maslov grading-change formulas.
decls.statement:
theorem J_self_sub_J_self_eq :
    GridState.J x x - GridState.J y y =
      2 * ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} {(R.right, R.top)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet)) -
            (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} {(R.right, R.bottom)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet)))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridRectangleBetween.J_pointSet_sub_eq
decls.doc:
Across a rectangle move, the change in the pairing of a state's points against an arbitrary
fixed point set `P` collapses to the four moving corners: the source corners `(left, bottom)`,
`(right, top)` against the target corners `(left, top)`, `(right, bottom)`. The shared part of the
two states cancels. The marking-pairing localizations specialize this at the `O`- and
`X`-marking sets.
decls.statement:
theorem J_pointSet_sub_eq (P : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) :
    GridPoint.J x.pointSet P - GridPoint.J y.pointSet P =
      (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} P + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} P) -
        (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} P + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} P)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_sub_maslovO_eq
decls.doc:
The difference of the `O`-Maslov grading at two grid states splits into the change in the
state self-pairing and twice the change in the `O`-marking pairing. The two states need not be
related: this is the algebraic shape of the grading formula.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovO_sub_maslovO_eq (x y : GridState n) :
    G.maslovO x - G.maslovO y =
      (GridState.J x x - GridState.J y y) - 2 * (G.JO x - G.JO y)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_sub_maslovX_eq
decls.doc:
The difference of the `X`-Maslov grading at two grid states splits into the change in the
state self-pairing and twice the change in the `X`-marking pairing.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovX_sub_maslovX_eq (x y : GridState n) :
    G.maslovX x - G.maslovX y =
      (GridState.J x x - GridState.J y y) - 2 * (G.JX x - G.JX y)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_sub_alexander_eq
decls.doc:
The Alexander grading change at two grid states is the difference of the two marking pairing
changes. The state self-pairing term is common to both Maslov gradings and the normalization
shift depends only on the grid size, so both cancel, leaving a marking-only identity that needs
no relationship between `x` and `y`.
decls.statement:
theorem alexander_sub_alexander_eq (x y : GridState n) :
    G.alexander x - G.alexander y = (G.JX x - G.JX y) - (G.JO x - G.JO y)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.JO_sub_JO_eq
decls.doc:
Across a rectangle move the `O`-marking pairing change collapses to the four corners: the
source corners `(left, bottom)`, `(right, top)` against the target corners `(left, top)`,
`(right, bottom)`. The two states share all but their corners, and the shared part cancels.
decls.statement:
theorem JO_sub_JO_eq (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.JO x - G.JO y =
      (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.OSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} G.OSet) -
        (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} G.OSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.OSet)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.JX_sub_JX_eq
decls.doc: Across a rectangle move the `X`-marking pairing change collapses to the four corners.
decls.statement:
theorem JX_sub_JX_eq (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.JX x - G.JX y =
      (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.XSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} G.XSet) -
        (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} G.XSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.XSet)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_change_rectangle
decls.doc:
The Alexander grading change across a rectangle move, localized to the four corners: it is the
four `X`-corner pairings minus the four `O`-corner pairings, in each case the two source corners
against the two target corners. The state self-pairing cancels (`alexander_sub_alexander_eq`) and
the shared squares cancel (`JX_sub_JX_eq`, `JO_sub_JO_eq`).
decls.statement:
theorem alexander_change_rectangle (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.alexander x - G.alexander y =
      ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.XSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} G.XSet) -
          (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} G.XSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.XSet)) -
        ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.OSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} G.OSet) -
          (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} G.OSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.OSet))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_change_rectangle
decls.doc:
The `O`-Maslov grading change across a rectangle move, with both the state self-pairing
change and the `O`-marking pairing change localized to the rectangle corners.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovO_change_rectangle (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.maslovO x - G.maslovO y =
      2 * ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} {(R.right, R.top)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet)) -
            (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} {(R.right, R.bottom)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet))) -
        2 * ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.OSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} G.OSet) -
          (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} G.OSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.OSet))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_change_rectangle
decls.doc:
The `X`-Maslov grading change across a rectangle move, with both the state self-pairing
change and the `X`-marking pairing change localized to the rectangle corners.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovX_change_rectangle (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.maslovX x - G.maslovX y =
      2 * ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} {(R.right, R.top)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet)) -
            (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} {(R.right, R.bottom)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet))) -
        2 * ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.XSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} G.XSet) -
          (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} G.XSet + GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.XSet))

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovOℤ
decls.doc:
The integer-valued `O`-Maslov grading of a grid state.

This is the integer formula `M_O(x) = I(x, x) - JNum(x, O) + I(O, O) + 1` obtained from the
rational definition once the two halves coming from the `J`-function cancel.
decls.statement: def maslovOℤ (x : GridState n) : ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovOℤ_def
decls.doc: The integer `O`-Maslov grading restated as its defining formula.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovOℤ_def (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovOℤ x =
      (GridPoint.I x.pointSet x.pointSet : ℤ) - GridPoint.JNum x.pointSet G.OSet
        + GridPoint.I G.OSet G.OSet + 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovXℤ
decls.doc: The integer-valued `X`-Maslov grading of a grid state.
decls.statement: def maslovXℤ (x : GridState n) : ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovXℤ_def
decls.doc: The integer `X`-Maslov grading restated as its defining formula.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovXℤ_def (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovXℤ x =
      (GridPoint.I x.pointSet x.pointSet : ℤ) - GridPoint.JNum x.pointSet G.XSet
        + GridPoint.I G.XSet G.XSet + 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovOℤ_eq_card
decls.doc:
The integer `O`-Maslov grading of a grid state written entirely as counts over column
indices. Every southwest count in `maslovOℤ` is a state or marking point-set count, so it collapses
to a column-pair count and the grading evaluates without unfolding any point-pair product.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovOℤ_eq_card (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovOℤ x =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ x p.1 < x p.2).card : ℤ)
        - ((Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ x p.1 < G.O p.2).card
          + (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ G.O p.1 < x p.2).card)
        + (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ G.O p.1 < G.O p.2).card + 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovXℤ_eq_card
decls.doc:
The integer `X`-Maslov grading of a grid state written entirely as counts over column
indices.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovXℤ_eq_card (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovXℤ x =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ x p.1 < x p.2).card : ℤ)
        - ((Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ x p.1 < G.X p.2).card
          + (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ G.X p.1 < x p.2).card)
        + (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ G.X p.1 < G.X p.2).card + 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovOℤ_O
decls.doc: The integer `O`-Maslov grading of the `O`-marking state is always `1`.
decls.statement: theorem maslovOℤ_O : G.maslovOℤ G.O = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovXℤ_X
decls.doc: The integer `X`-Maslov grading of the `X`-marking state is always `1`.
decls.statement: theorem maslovXℤ_X : G.maslovXℤ G.X = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_eq_intCast
decls.doc:
The rational `O`-Maslov grading is the cast of its integer counterpart: `M_O` is an
integer. This specializes the general self-pairing integrality `GridPoint.JDiff_self_eq_intCast`
to the `O`-markings.
decls.statement: theorem maslovO_eq_intCast (x : GridState n) : G.maslovO x = (G.maslovOℤ x : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_eq_intCast
decls.doc:
The rational `X`-Maslov grading is the cast of its integer counterpart: `M_X` is an
integer. This specializes the general self-pairing integrality `GridPoint.JDiff_self_eq_intCast`
to the `X`-markings.
decls.statement: theorem maslovX_eq_intCast (x : GridState n) : G.maslovX x = (G.maslovXℤ x : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_exists_int
decls.doc: The `O`-Maslov grading is an integer.
decls.statement: theorem maslovO_exists_int (x : GridState n) : ∃ m : ℤ, G.maslovO x = (m : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_exists_int
decls.doc: The `X`-Maslov grading is an integer.
decls.statement: theorem maslovX_exists_int (x : GridState n) : ∃ m : ℤ, G.maslovX x = (m : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexanderTwoℤ
decls.doc:
The integer numerator of twice the Alexander grading, `2 · A(x) = M_O(x) - M_X(x) - (n - 1)`.
The normalization shift `(n - 1)` is taken over `ℤ`, so the formula is literal at every `n`.
decls.statement: def alexanderTwoℤ (x : GridState n) : ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexanderTwoℤ_def
decls.doc: The integer numerator of twice the Alexander grading restated as its defining formula.
decls.statement:
theorem alexanderTwoℤ_def (x : GridState n) :
    G.alexanderTwoℤ x = G.maslovOℤ x - G.maslovXℤ x - ((n : ℤ) - 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.two_mul_alexander_eq_intCast
decls.doc:
Twice the Alexander grading is an integer: it is the difference of the integer Maslov
gradings, corrected by the normalization shift. This stops short of integrality of `A` itself,
which is the genuinely parity-sensitive statement.
decls.statement:
theorem two_mul_alexander_eq_intCast (x : GridState n) :
    2 * G.alexander x = (G.alexanderTwoℤ x : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.two_mul_alexander_exists_int
decls.doc:
Twice the Alexander grading is an integer; equivalently, the Alexander grading is a
half-integer.
decls.statement:
theorem two_mul_alexander_exists_int (x : GridState n) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, 2 * G.alexander x = (m : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovOℤ_transpose
decls.doc: The integer-valued `O`-Maslov grading is invariant under the diagonal reflection.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovOℤ_transpose (x : GridState n) :
    G.transpose.maslovOℤ x.transpose = G.maslovOℤ x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovXℤ_transpose
decls.doc: The integer-valued `X`-Maslov grading is invariant under the diagonal reflection.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovXℤ_transpose (x : GridState n) :
    G.transpose.maslovXℤ x.transpose = G.maslovXℤ x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexanderTwoℤ_transpose
decls.doc:
The integer numerator of twice the Alexander grading is invariant under the diagonal
reflection.
decls.statement:
theorem alexanderTwoℤ_transpose (x : GridState n) :
    G.transpose.alexanderTwoℤ x.transpose = G.alexanderTwoℤ x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovOℤ_rotate
decls.doc: The integer-valued `O`-Maslov grading is invariant under the half-turn rotation.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovOℤ_rotate (x : GridState n) :
    G.rotate.maslovOℤ x.rotate = G.maslovOℤ x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovXℤ_rotate
decls.doc: The integer-valued `X`-Maslov grading is invariant under the half-turn rotation.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovXℤ_rotate (x : GridState n) :
    G.rotate.maslovXℤ x.rotate = G.maslovXℤ x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexanderTwoℤ_rotate
decls.doc:
The integer numerator of twice the Alexander grading is invariant under the half-turn
rotation.
decls.statement:
theorem alexanderTwoℤ_rotate (x : GridState n) :
    G.rotate.alexanderTwoℤ x.rotate = G.alexanderTwoℤ x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovOℤ_swapMarkings
decls.doc: The marking swap exchanges the integer-valued Maslov gradings.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovOℤ_swapMarkings (x : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.maslovOℤ x = G.maslovXℤ x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovXℤ_swapMarkings
decls.doc: The marking swap exchanges the integer-valued Maslov gradings.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovXℤ_swapMarkings (x : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.maslovXℤ x = G.maslovOℤ x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexanderTwoℤ_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
The marking swap negates the integer numerator of twice the Alexander grading, up to twice
the normalization shift: `2·A_swap(x) = −2·A(x) − 2(n − 1)`.
decls.statement:
theorem alexanderTwoℤ_swapMarkings (x : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.alexanderTwoℤ x = -G.alexanderTwoℤ x - 2 * ((n : ℤ) - 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO
decls.doc:
The `O`-Maslov grading of a grid state.

This is the formula `M_O(x) = J(x - O, x - O) + 1`.
decls.statement: def maslovO (x : GridState n) : ℚ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_def
decls.doc: The `O`-Maslov grading as a `JDiff` self-pairing plus one.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovO_def (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovO x = GridPoint.JDiff x.pointSet G.OSet x.pointSet G.OSet + 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_eq
decls.doc: The expanded `O`-Maslov grading formula.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovO_eq (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovO x = GridState.J x x - 2 * G.JO x + GridState.J G.O G.O + 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX
decls.doc:
The `X`-Maslov grading of a grid state.

This is the formula `M_X(x) = J(x - X, x - X) + 1`.
decls.statement: def maslovX (x : GridState n) : ℚ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_def
decls.doc: The `X`-Maslov grading as a `JDiff` self-pairing plus one.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovX_def (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovX x = GridPoint.JDiff x.pointSet G.XSet x.pointSet G.XSet + 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_eq
decls.doc: The expanded `X`-Maslov grading formula.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovX_eq (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovX x = GridState.J x x - 2 * G.JX x + GridState.J G.X G.X + 1

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander
decls.doc:
The Alexander grading of a grid state.

This is the formula `A(x) = (M_O(x) - M_X(x)) / 2 - (n - 1) / 2`. The shift is cast
through `ℤ`, so the formula remains literal at `n = 0`; integer-valuedness is a later grading
theorem.
decls.statement: def alexander (x : GridState n) : ℚ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_def
decls.doc:
The Alexander grading as the difference of the two Maslov gradings with the standard
normalization shift.
decls.statement:
theorem alexander_def (x : GridState n) :
    G.alexander x =
      (G.maslovO x - G.maslovX x) / 2 - (((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_eq
decls.doc: The Alexander grading with the two Maslov formulas expanded.
decls.statement:
theorem alexander_eq (x : GridState n) :
    G.alexander x =
      (2 * (G.JX x - G.JO x) + (GridState.J G.O G.O - GridState.J G.X G.X) -
        (((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ)) / 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_sub_maslovX_eq
decls.doc:
The difference of the two Maslov gradings is twice the Alexander grading plus the
normalization shift.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovO_sub_maslovX_eq (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovO x - G.maslovX x =
      2 * G.alexander x + (((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_eq_neg_shift_of_maslov_eq
decls.doc:
Replacing the two Maslov gradings by the same value leaves only the normalization shift in
the Alexander formula.
decls.statement:
theorem alexander_eq_neg_shift_of_maslov_eq {x : GridState n} (h : G.maslovO x = G.maslovX x) :
    G.alexander x = -(((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_transpose
decls.doc: The `O`-Maslov grading is invariant under the diagonal reflection.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovO_transpose (x : GridState n) :
    G.transpose.maslovO x.transpose = G.maslovO x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_transpose
decls.doc: The `X`-Maslov grading is invariant under the diagonal reflection.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovX_transpose (x : GridState n) :
    G.transpose.maslovX x.transpose = G.maslovX x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_transpose
decls.doc:
The Alexander grading is invariant under the diagonal reflection. The normalization shift
depends only on the common grid size, so it cancels between the two diagrams.
decls.statement:
theorem alexander_transpose (x : GridState n) :
    G.transpose.alexander x.transpose = G.alexander x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_rotate
decls.doc: The `O`-Maslov grading is invariant under the half-turn rotation.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovO_rotate (x : GridState n) :
    G.rotate.maslovO x.rotate = G.maslovO x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_rotate
decls.doc: The `X`-Maslov grading is invariant under the half-turn rotation.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovX_rotate (x : GridState n) :
    G.rotate.maslovX x.rotate = G.maslovX x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_rotate
decls.doc:
The Alexander grading is invariant under the half-turn rotation. The normalization shift
depends only on the common grid size, so it cancels between the two diagrams.
decls.statement:
theorem alexander_rotate (x : GridState n) :
    G.rotate.alexander x.rotate = G.alexander x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_swapMarkings
decls.doc: The marking swap exchanges the two Maslov gradings: `M_O` of the swap is `M_X`.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovO_swapMarkings (x : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.maslovO x = G.maslovX x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_swapMarkings
decls.doc: The marking swap exchanges the two Maslov gradings: `M_X` of the swap is `M_O`.
decls.statement:
theorem maslovX_swapMarkings (x : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.maslovX x = G.maslovO x

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_swapMarkings
decls.doc:
The marking swap negates the Alexander grading, up to the constant normalization shift:
`A_swap(x) = -A(x) - (n - 1)`. The grading is built antisymmetrically from the two Maslov
gradings, which the swap exchanges, while the shift depends only on the grid size.
decls.statement:
theorem alexander_swapMarkings (x : GridState n) :
    G.swapMarkings.alexander x = -G.alexander x - (((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles
decls.doc:
The fully blocked boundaries, viewed as a submodule of the fully blocked cycles: the cycles
that are hit by the differential. This is `B ⊓ Z` sitting inside `Z`, and equals `B` itself once
the differential squares to zero (`fullyBlockedBoundaries_le_cycles`).
decls.statement: def fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles : Submodule (ZMod 2) G.fullyBlockedCycles

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles
decls.doc:
A cycle lies in `fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles` exactly when it is a fully blocked boundary,
letting membership be established without unfolding `submoduleOf`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles (x : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :
    x ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles ↔
      (x : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedHomology
decls.doc:
The fully blocked grid homology: the cycles of the fully blocked differential modulo the
boundaries that lie inside them.

This is the subquotient `Z ⧸ (B ⊓ Z)`, which is the genuine homology `Z / B` once every boundary
is a cycle, i.e. once the differential squares to zero (`fullyBlockedBoundaries_le_cycles`). Using
the subquotient lets the object be named uniformly, before the square-zero theorem is available in
every grid size.
decls.statement: abbrev fullyBlockedHomology : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedHomology_mk_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Two cycles represent the same fully blocked homology class exactly when their difference is a
boundary. This is the defining relation of the homology and does not need the differential to
square to zero.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedHomology_mk_eq_iff (a b : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : G.fullyBlockedHomology) = Submodule.Quotient.mk b ↔
      (a : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) - b ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedHomology_mk_eq_zero_iff
decls.doc:
A fully blocked homology class is zero exactly when a representing cycle is a boundary,
letting classes be shown trivial without unfolding `submoduleOf`.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedHomology_mk_eq_zero_iff (a : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : G.fullyBlockedHomology) = 0 ↔
      (a : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedHomologyEquivChainOfLeTwo
decls.doc:
On grids of size at most two the fully blocked differential vanishes, so the homology is the
whole chain module: cycles are everything and the only boundary is zero.
decls.statement:
def fullyBlockedHomologyEquivChainOfLeTwo (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    G.fullyBlockedHomology ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] GridChain (ZMod 2) n

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedHomologyEquivChainOfLeTwo_apply_mk
decls.doc: The small-grid equivalence sends the homology class of a cycle to its underlying chain.
decls.statement:
theorem fullyBlockedHomologyEquivChainOfLeTwo_apply_mk (hn : n ≤ 2)
    (c : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :
    G.fullyBlockedHomologyEquivChainOfLeTwo hn (Submodule.Quotient.mk c) =
      (c : GridChain (ZMod 2) n)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.natCard_fullyBlockedHomology_of_le_two
decls.doc:
In grid size at most two the fully blocked homology has `2 ^ n!` elements: the size of the
whole chain module, since the differential vanishes.
decls.statement:
theorem natCard_fullyBlockedHomology_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    Nat.card G.fullyBlockedHomology = 2 ^ n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_of_le_two
decls.doc: In grid size at most two the fully blocked homology has `ZMod 2`-dimension `n!`.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) G.fullyBlockedHomology = n.factorial

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.natCard_fullyBlockedHomology_of_two
decls.doc: Every `2 × 2` grid has a four-element fully blocked homology.
decls.statement:
theorem natCard_fullyBlockedHomology_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) :
    Nat.card G.fullyBlockedHomology = 4

decls.name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_of_two
decls.doc:
Every `2 × 2` grid has a two-dimensional fully blocked homology, the rank of the
stabilization factor `W = 𝔽 ⊕ 𝔽` predicted for the unknot.
decls.statement:
theorem finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) G.fullyBlockedHomology = 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.IsSouthWest
decls.doc:
A grid point is strictly southwest of another when both its column and row coordinates are
strictly smaller. This is the affine point-pair relation used in the grid `J`-function; it is
not the toroidal cyclic order used for rectangles.
decls.statement: def IsSouthWest (p q : Fin n × Fin n) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.decidableIsSouthWest
decls.doc: The strict southwest relation has a decidable instance.
decls.statement: instance decidableIsSouthWest (p q : Fin n × Fin n) : Decidable (IsSouthWest p q)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.isSouthWest_iff
decls.doc: The southwest relation in coordinate form.
decls.statement:
theorem isSouthWest_iff (p q : Fin n × Fin n) :
    IsSouthWest p q ↔ p.1.val < q.1.val ∧ p.2.val < q.2.val

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.not_isSouthWest_self
decls.doc: A point is not strictly southwest of itself.
decls.statement: theorem not_isSouthWest_self (p : Fin n × Fin n) : ¬ IsSouthWest p p

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.ne_of_isSouthWest
decls.doc: A strictly southwest pair has distinct endpoints.
decls.statement: theorem ne_of_isSouthWest {p q : Fin n × Fin n} (h : IsSouthWest p q) : p ≠ q

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.not_isSouthWest_swap
decls.doc: The strict southwest relation is asymmetric.
decls.statement:
theorem not_isSouthWest_swap {p q : Fin n × Fin n} (h : IsSouthWest p q) :
    ¬ IsSouthWest q p

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I
decls.doc: The ordered count of pairs `(p, q) ∈ s × t` with `p` strictly southwest of `q`.
decls.statement: def I (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : ℕ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_def
decls.doc: The ordered southwest count as the cardinality of the filtered product of point sets.
decls.statement:
theorem I_def (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) :
    I s t =
      ((s ×ˢ t).filter fun pq : (Fin n × Fin n) × (Fin n × Fin n) =>
        IsSouthWest pq.1 pq.2).card

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.mem_filter_product_isSouthWest
decls.doc: Membership in the finite set counted by `GridPoint.I`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_filter_product_isSouthWest (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n))
  (pq : (Fin n × Fin n) × (Fin n × Fin n)) :
    pq ∈ (s ×ˢ t).filter (fun pq => IsSouthWest pq.1 pq.2) ↔
      pq.1 ∈ s ∧ pq.2 ∈ t ∧ IsSouthWest pq.1 pq.2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_empty_left
decls.doc: The ordered southwest count is zero when the left point set is empty.
decls.statement: theorem I_empty_left (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : I ∅ s = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_empty_right
decls.doc: The ordered southwest count is zero when the right point set is empty.
decls.statement: theorem I_empty_right (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : I s ∅ = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_singleton_singleton
decls.doc: The ordered southwest count of singleton point sets is one exactly for a southwest pair.
decls.statement:
theorem I_singleton_singleton (p q : Fin n × Fin n) :
    I {p} {q} = if IsSouthWest p q then 1 else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_singleton_self
decls.doc: No point contributes a southwest pair with itself.
decls.statement: theorem I_singleton_self (p : Fin n × Fin n) : I {p} {p} = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_union_left
decls.doc: The ordered southwest count is additive in the left point set over disjoint unions.
decls.statement:
theorem I_union_left {s₁ s₂ t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    I (s₁ ∪ s₂) t = I s₁ t + I s₂ t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_union_right
decls.doc: The ordered southwest count is additive in the right point set over disjoint unions.
decls.statement:
theorem I_union_right {s t₁ t₂ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : Disjoint t₁ t₂) :
    I s (t₁ ∪ t₂) = I s t₁ + I s t₂

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_insert_left
decls.doc: The ordered southwest count after inserting a fresh point on the left.
decls.statement:
theorem I_insert_left {p : Fin n × Fin n} {s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : p ∉ s) :
    I (insert p s) t = I {p} t + I s t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.I_insert_right
decls.doc: The ordered southwest count after inserting a fresh point on the right.
decls.statement:
theorem I_insert_right {p : Fin n × Fin n} {s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : p ∉ t) :
    I s (insert p t) = I s {p} + I s t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum
decls.doc:
The numerator of the symmetrized `J`-function. Keeping the numerator as a natural number is
convenient for parity and integrality lemmas before passing to rational values.
decls.statement: def JNum (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : ℕ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_def
decls.doc: The numerator of `J` is the sum of the two ordered southwest counts.
decls.statement: theorem JNum_def (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : JNum s t = I s t + I t s

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_self
decls.doc:
The symmetrized numerator of the `J`-function on a point set with itself is even: it is twice
the ordered southwest count.
decls.statement: theorem JNum_self (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : JNum s s = 2 * I s s

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J
decls.doc: The rational-valued symmetrized grid `J`-function.
decls.statement: def J (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : ℚ

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_def
decls.doc: The rational-valued `J`-function is half of its symmetrized numerator.
decls.statement: theorem J_def (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : GridPoint.J s t = ((JNum s t : ℕ) : ℚ) / 2

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_self
decls.doc:
The `J`-function on a point set with itself is an integer, namely the ordered southwest
count. The two southwest comparisons of a pair contribute symmetrically, so the division by two
is exact.
decls.statement: theorem J_self (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : GridPoint.J s s = (I s s : ℚ)

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_comm
decls.doc: The numerator of `J` is symmetric.
decls.statement: theorem JNum_comm (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : JNum s t = JNum t s

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_comm
decls.doc: The grid `J`-function is symmetric.
decls.statement: theorem J_comm (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : GridPoint.J s t = GridPoint.J t s

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_empty_left
decls.doc: The numerator of `J` vanishes when the left point set is empty.
decls.statement: theorem JNum_empty_left (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : JNum ∅ s = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_empty_right
decls.doc: The numerator of `J` vanishes when the right point set is empty.
decls.statement: theorem JNum_empty_right (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : JNum s ∅ = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_union_left
decls.doc: The numerator of `J` is additive in the left point set over disjoint unions.
decls.statement:
theorem JNum_union_left {s₁ s₂ t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    JNum (s₁ ∪ s₂) t = JNum s₁ t + JNum s₂ t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_union_right
decls.doc: The numerator of `J` is additive in the right point set over disjoint unions.
decls.statement:
theorem JNum_union_right {s t₁ t₂ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : Disjoint t₁ t₂) :
    JNum s (t₁ ∪ t₂) = JNum s t₁ + JNum s t₂

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_insert_left
decls.doc: The numerator of `J` after inserting a fresh point on the left.
decls.statement:
theorem JNum_insert_left {p : Fin n × Fin n} {s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : p ∉ s) :
    JNum (insert p s) t = JNum {p} t + JNum s t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNum_insert_right
decls.doc: The numerator of `J` after inserting a fresh point on the right.
decls.statement:
theorem JNum_insert_right {p : Fin n × Fin n} {s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : p ∉ t) :
    JNum s (insert p t) = JNum s {p} + JNum s t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_empty_left
decls.doc: `J` vanishes when the left point set is empty.
decls.statement: theorem J_empty_left (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : GridPoint.J ∅ s = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_empty_right
decls.doc: `J` vanishes when the right point set is empty.
decls.statement: theorem J_empty_right (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) : GridPoint.J s ∅ = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_union_left
decls.doc: The grid `J`-function is additive in the left point set over disjoint unions.
decls.statement:
theorem J_union_left {s₁ s₂ t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    GridPoint.J (s₁ ∪ s₂) t = GridPoint.J s₁ t + GridPoint.J s₂ t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_union_right
decls.doc: The grid `J`-function is additive in the right point set over disjoint unions.
decls.statement:
theorem J_union_right {s t₁ t₂ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : Disjoint t₁ t₂) :
    GridPoint.J s (t₁ ∪ t₂) = GridPoint.J s t₁ + GridPoint.J s t₂

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_insert_left
decls.doc: The grid `J`-function after inserting a fresh point on the left.
decls.statement:
theorem J_insert_left {p : Fin n × Fin n} {s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : p ∉ s) :
    GridPoint.J (insert p s) t = GridPoint.J {p} t + GridPoint.J s t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_insert_right
decls.doc: The grid `J`-function after inserting a fresh point on the right.
decls.statement:
theorem J_insert_right {p : Fin n × Fin n} {s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} (h : p ∉ t) :
    GridPoint.J s (insert p t) = GridPoint.J s {p} + GridPoint.J s t

decls.name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JDiff
decls.doc:
The bilinear extension of the grid `J`-function to formal differences of point sets.

`JDiff s a t b` means `J(s - a, t - b)`, expanded as
`J s t - J s b - J a t + J a b`.
